  delivery_point varchar [note: 'Named electrical delivery point or pricing node where energy is transferred under the Power Purchase Agreement (e.g., RTO/ISO hub, busbar, interconnection point). Aligns with LMP settlement nodes in the Day-Ahead Market (DAM) and Real-Time Market (RTM).']
  effective_date date [note: 'Calendar date on which the Power Purchase Agreement becomes legally binding and energy delivery obligations commence. Used in IRP resource adequacy analysis and long-term supply portfolio management.']
  energy_price_per_mwh decimal(12,4) [note: 'Contracted energy price in USD per Megawatt-Hour (MWh) for fixed-price Power Purchase Agreements. For index-linked contracts, this represents the base or floor price. Null for tolling agreements where pricing is fuel-cost-based.']
  execution_date date [note: 'Calendar date on which all parties signed and executed the Power Purchase Agreement. Distinct from the effective date; used for FERC filing timelines and contract audit trails.']
  expiration_date date [note: 'Calendar date on which the Power Purchase Agreement term ends and delivery obligations cease. Nullable for evergreen or open-ended agreements. Critical for IRP long-term supply portfolio planning and contract renewal workflows.']
  ferc_docket_number varchar [note: 'FERC-assigned docket number for the regulatory filing associated with this Power Purchase Agreement. Used for tracking FERC market-based rate authority approvals and compliance reporting.']
  ferc_filing_status varchar [note: 'Current status of the FERC (Federal Energy Regulatory Commission) market-based rate authority filing associated with this Power Purchase Agreement. Tracks regulatory approval lifecycle for wholesale market transactions.']
  force_majeure_clause boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the Power Purchase Agreement includes a force majeure clause that excuses performance obligations under extraordinary circumstances (natural disasters, grid emergencies, regulatory actions). True if clause is present.']
  fuel_type varchar [note: 'Primary fuel or generation technology of the contracted resource. Used for Renewable Portfolio Standard (RPS) compliance tracking, GHG emissions reporting, and IRP resource mix analysis. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: solar|wind|hydro|nuclear|natural_gas|coal|oil|geothermal|biomass|storage|other — promote to reference product]']
  is_renewable boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the contracted generation resource qualifies as renewable energy under applicable state Renewable Portfolio Standard (RPS) regulations. True if renewable; False if conventional. Drives REC (Renewable Energy Certificate) eligibility determination.']
  minimum_take_mwh decimal(18,3) [note: 'Minimum energy volume in Megawatt-Hours (MWh) that the buyer is contractually obligated to take or pay for during each contract period. Represents the take-or-pay floor for financial settlement purposes.']
  nerc_region varchar [note: 'NERC (North American Electric Reliability Corporation) reliability region in which the contracted generation resource is located. Used for NERC compliance reporting and resource adequacy assessments. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: NPCC|SERC|RFC|MRO|WECC|TRE|FRCC — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]']
  price_index_reference varchar [note: 'Name or identifier of the market price index used for index-linked Power Purchase Agreements (e.g., Day-Ahead LMP at a specific hub, Henry Hub natural gas index, ICE power index). Null for fixed-price contracts.']
  project_name varchar [note: 'Name of the generation project or facility that is the source of supply under this Power Purchase Agreement (e.g., \'Sunrise Solar Farm\', \'Blue Ridge Wind Project\'). Distinct from the contract name; identifies the physical asset.']
  puc_approval_date date [note: 'Date on which the state Public Utility Commission (PUC) approved this Power Purchase Agreement. Null if approval is not required or not yet received.']
  puc_approval_required boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this Power Purchase Agreement requires approval from the state Public Utility Commission (PUC) before becoming effective. True if PUC approval is required; False if the contract is exempt from state regulatory review.']
  rec_bundled boolean [note: 'Indicates whether Renewable Energy Certificates (RECs) are bundled with the energy delivery under this Power Purchase Agreement. True if RECs transfer with energy; False if RECs are unbundled or retained by the seller. Critical for RPS compliance accounting.']
  rec_quantity_annual decimal(18,3) [note: 'Expected annual quantity of Renewable Energy Certificates (RECs) transferred under this Power Purchase Agreement when rec_bundled is True. Measured in MWh-equivalent RECs. Used for RPS compliance portfolio management.']
  rto_iso_code varchar [note: 'Reference to the Regional Transmission Organization (RTO) or Independent System Operator (ISO) market in which this Power Purchase Agreement is settled (e.g., PJM, MISO, CAISO, ERCOT, SPP). Governs LMP settlement and market rules.']
  settlement_currency varchar [note: 'ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for financial settlement of this Power Purchase Agreement (e.g., USD). Supports multi-currency contract management for cross-border PPAs.']
  state_jurisdiction varchar [note: 'Two-letter US state code identifying the primary regulatory jurisdiction governing this Power Purchase Agreement. Determines applicable PUC oversight, RPS requirements, and state-level reporting obligations.']
  termination_provisions varchar [note: 'Description of early termination rights, notice periods, and termination payment obligations under the Power Purchase Agreement. Captures key contractual terms for legal and regulatory compliance review.']
  updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp when this Power Purchase Agreement record was most recently modified in the data platform. Supports change tracking, audit trail, and data lineage per SOX and FERC record-keeping requirements.']

  Note: 'Master record for Power Purchase Agreements governing long-term wholesale energy procurement and sale. Captures contract type (fixed-price, index-linked, tolling), contracted capacity (MW), energy volume (MWh), delivery point, term dates, REC bundling provisions, curtailment rights, force majeure clauses, and FERC filing status. Supports IRP resource adequacy analysis and long-term supply portfolio management.'
}

Table market.capacity_obligation {
  capacity_obligation_id varchar [pk, note: 'Unique surrogate identifier for each capacity market obligation record registered with an RTO/ISO. Primary key for the capacity_obligation data product in the Silver Layer lakehouse.']
  capacity_resource_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the generation or demand response resource registered to fulfill this capacity obligation. Links to the asset or resource master record in the Asset Management domain.']
  capex_project_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to finance.capex_project. Business justification: Capacity obligations often trigger capital investment decisions (generation upgrades, new builds, demand response infrastructure) to meet committed MW. Links obligation to the capital project for cost']
  master_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to asset.asset_master. Business justification: Capacity obligations must link to committed physical asset to validate installed capacity matches market commitment, track mandatory performance testing requirements, coordinate maintenance outages wi']
  ppa_contract_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the Power Purchase Agreement (PPA) contract under which this capacity obligation is fulfilled, if applicable. Links to the PPA contract master record. Null for obligations fulfilled by utility-owned generation assets.']
  procurement_contract_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to supply.procurement_contract. Business justification: Capacity obligations depend on underlying procurement contracts for fuel supply, equipment maintenance, or tolling agreements that enable capacity delivery. Critical for cost allocation, performance g']
  transfer_agreement_id varchar [note: 'Reference to a bilateral capacity transfer agreement if this obligation has been partially or fully transferred to or from another market participant. Null if no transfer applies. Used for capacity position management and FERC market-based rate compliance.']
  zone_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the locational deliverability area (LDA), capacity zone, or planning zone within the RTO/ISO footprint where this obligation applies (e.g., PJM MAAC, MISO Zone 7, ISO-NE NEMA). Determines applicable clearing price and performance requirements.']
  auction_clearing_date date [note: 'Date on which the capacity auction cleared and this obligation was established. For bilateral transactions, the date the agreement was executed. Used as the principal business event date for financial recognition and FERC market-based rate reporting.']
  auction_code varchar [note: 'Reference to the capacity market auction event (e.g., PJM Base Residual Auction, MISO Planning Resource Auction, ISO-NE Forward Capacity Auction) from which this obligation was established. Links to the auction master record.']
  auction_type varchar [note: 'Classification of the auction mechanism through which this obligation was established. \'base_residual\' is the primary annual auction; \'incremental\' covers subsequent adjustment auctions; \'bilateral\' covers negotiated capacity transactions; \'self_supply\' covers vertically integrated utility self-commitment; \'reliability_must_run\' covers RMR designations.']
  capacity_qualification_date date [note: 'Date on which the RTO/ISO formally qualified this resource to participate in the capacity market for the applicable delivery year. Marks the point at which the resource\'s UCAP value was certified and the obligation became binding.']
  clearing_price_per_mw_day decimal(12,4) [note: 'The capacity auction clearing price in dollars per Megawatt per day ($/MW-day) at which this obligation was established. Multiplied by committed_mw and the number of days in the delivery year to determine total capacity revenue or cost. Classified confidential as commercially sensitive market pricing data.']
  committed_mw decimal(12,4) [note: 'The quantity of capacity in Megawatts (MW) committed under this obligation as cleared in the capacity auction or bilaterally agreed. Represents the principal quantitative fact of the obligation. Used for resource adequacy compliance, FERC reporting, and IRP analysis.']
  compliance_status varchar [note: 'Current regulatory compliance status of the capacity obligation relative to RTO/ISO performance requirements and FERC market-based rate authority conditions. \'compliant\' indicates all performance obligations are met; \'deficient\' indicates a shortfall triggering non-performance charges; \'under_review\' indicates an open RTO/ISO investigation; \'waived\' indicates an approved force majeure or tariff waiver; \'exempt\' indicates a regulatory exemption applies.']
  curtailment_event_count varchar [note: 'Number of RTO/ISO-declared capacity performance events (e.g., PJM Performance Assessment Hours, MISO Emergency Operating Procedures) during which this resource was called upon to perform within the current delivery year. Used for compliance tracking and non-performance charge calculation.']
  delivery_year varchar [note: 'The RTO/ISO-defined delivery year (e.g., \'2025/2026\') during which the capacity obligation must be fulfilled. Typically spans June 1 through May 31 for PJM; aligns with the planning year used in the auction. Critical for resource adequacy planning and FERC capacity market reporting.']
  eford_rate decimal(6,4) [note: 'The Equivalent Forced Outage Rate on Demand (EFORd) applied to this resource for the delivery year, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.0250 = 2.50%). Used by the RTO/ISO to derate installed capacity to Unforced Capacity (UCAP). Sourced from NERC GADS reporting and RTO/ISO capacity qualification processes.']
  force_majeure_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether a force majeure event (True) has been declared for this obligation, potentially relieving the utility of non-performance charges for affected performance events. Triggers a separate RTO/ISO review and waiver process.']
  installed_capacity_mw decimal(12,4) [note: 'The nameplate or installed capacity in Megawatts (MW) of the resource registered for this obligation, prior to any derating adjustments. Used as the baseline for UCAP calculations and resource adequacy assessments in MISO and ISO-NE markets.']
  is_demand_response boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this capacity obligation is fulfilled by a Demand Response (DR) resource (True) rather than a generation asset (False). DR capacity obligations are subject to different performance measurement rules under FERC Order 745 and RTO/ISO DR tariff provisions.']
  is_self_scheduled boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this capacity obligation was established through a self-schedule (True) rather than through a competitive auction clearing (False). Self-scheduled resources bypass the auction clearing price and are committed at cost-of-service or bilateral rates. Relevant for vertically integrated utilities under state PUC jurisdiction.']
  last_performance_test_date date [note: 'Date of the most recent RTO/ISO-administered or utility-conducted capacity performance test for the resource fulfilling this obligation. Used to verify continued eligibility and compliance with performance threshold requirements.']
  locational_deliverability_area varchar [note: 'The name or code of the Locational Deliverability Area (LDA) or sub-zone within the RTO/ISO footprint where this capacity obligation must be physically deliverable. Relevant for constrained zones with higher clearing prices. Used for transmission planning and resource adequacy analysis.']
  non_performance_charge_amount decimal(18,4) [note: 'Cumulative non-performance charge amount in US Dollars (USD) assessed against this obligation for the current delivery year due to resource underperformance during capacity performance events. Used for financial exposure tracking, FERC reporting, and collections management.']
  non_performance_charge_rate decimal(12,4) [note: 'The penalty rate in dollars per Megawatt-hour ($/MWh) applied when the resource fails to perform during a capacity performance event below the performance threshold. Used to calculate potential financial exposure for compliance risk management and FERC reporting.']
  notes varchar [note: 'Free-text field for operational notes, RTO/ISO correspondence references, regulatory filing cross-references, or other contextual information relevant to this capacity obligation. Not used for structured data.']
  obligation_end_date date [note: 'Calendar date on which the capacity obligation period concludes. Typically May 31 of the delivery year for PJM-style markets. Nullable for multi-year obligations with rolling terms. Used for expiry tracking and resource adequacy planning.']
  obligation_number varchar [note: 'Externally-known alphanumeric identifier assigned by the RTO/ISO (e.g., PJM RPM obligation ID, MISO Planning Resource Auction ID, ISO-NE FCM commitment reference) that uniquely identifies this obligation in the market operator\'s system. Used for FERC reporting and RTO/ISO reconciliation.']
  obligation_start_date date [note: 'Calendar date on which the capacity obligation period begins and the utility must demonstrate resource availability. Typically June 1 of the delivery year for PJM-style markets. Used for compliance monitoring and IRP scheduling.']
  obligation_status varchar [note: 'Current lifecycle status of the capacity obligation. \'active\' indicates the obligation is in force during the delivery year; \'pending\' indicates awaiting RTO/ISO confirmation; \'suspended\' indicates temporarily relieved; \'terminated\' indicates early exit; \'expired\' indicates the obligation period has concluded.']
  obligation_type varchar [note: 'Classification of the capacity obligation by resource category. \'capacity_supply\' covers generation assets; \'demand_response\' covers DR programs; \'energy_efficiency\' covers EE resources; \'import\'/\'export\' cover inter-regional capacity transactions. Drives applicable performance standards and penalty calculations.']
  performance_test_result_mw decimal(12,4) [note: 'The demonstrated output in Megawatts (MW) achieved during the most recent capacity performance test. Compared against committed_mw to assess compliance with the obligation and determine if non-performance charges apply.']
  performance_threshold_pct decimal(6,4) [note: 'The minimum performance ratio (expressed as a decimal percentage, e.g., 0.9750 = 97.50%) that the resource must achieve during capacity performance events to avoid Non-Performance Charges. Defined by the RTO/ISO tariff for the applicable delivery year and resource type.']
  planning_reserve_margin_pct decimal(6,4) [note: 'The RTO/ISO-mandated planning reserve margin (expressed as a decimal percentage, e.g., 0.1650 = 16.50%) applicable to this obligation\'s delivery year and zone. Used to verify that the utility\'s total capacity portfolio meets resource adequacy requirements for IRP and regulatory filings.']
  rec_eligible boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the resource fulfilling this capacity obligation is eligible to generate Renewable Energy Certificates (RECs) under the applicable state Renewable Portfolio Standard (RPS). Used for RPS compliance tracking and green energy procurement reporting.']
  record_created_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp when this capacity obligation record was first captured in the Silver Layer lakehouse. Follows ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Used for audit trail and data lineage purposes.']
  record_updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp when this capacity obligation record was most recently modified in the Silver Layer lakehouse. Follows ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Used for change tracking, incremental ETL processing, and audit compliance.']
  resource_type varchar [note: 'Technology classification of the resource fulfilling the capacity obligation. Used for resource adequacy portfolio analysis, RPS compliance tracking, and IRP reporting. Aligns with NERC Generator Inventory and FERC Form 1 resource classifications. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: thermal|nuclear|hydro|wind|solar|storage|demand_response|other — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]']
  rto_iso_code varchar [note: 'Code identifying the Regional Transmission Organization or Independent System Operator (RTO/ISO) with which this capacity obligation is registered. Determines the applicable tariff, auction rules, and compliance framework. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: PJM|MISO|ISO-NE|NYISO|CAISO|SPP|ERCOT — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]']
  source_system_code varchar [note: 'Code identifying the operational system of record from which this capacity obligation record was sourced (e.g., ABB or GE Energy Management System, RTO/ISO market portal, SAP S/4HANA, or manual entry). Used for data lineage tracking in the Silver Layer lakehouse.']
  total_capacity_revenue decimal(18,4) [note: 'Total expected capacity revenue in US Dollars (USD) for the full obligation period, calculated as clearing_price_per_mw_day × committed_mw × obligation days. Stored as a pre-computed contract value for financial planning, EBITDA forecasting, and FERC market-based rate filings. Classified confidential as commercially sensitive financial data.']
  unforced_capacity_mw decimal(12,4) [note: 'The Unforced Capacity (UCAP) value in Megawatts (MW) after applying the Equivalent Forced Outage Rate (EFORd) derating factor to the installed capacity. UCAP is the RTO/ISO-recognized capacity credit used for compliance verification and auction clearing. Distinct from committed_mw which reflects the cleared auction quantity.']

  Note: 'Master record for capacity market obligations and commitments registered with an RTO/ISO (e.g., PJM RPM, MISO Planning Resource Auction, ISO-NE FCM). Tracks obligation period, committed MW, resource type, zone, auction clearing price ($/MW-day), performance penalty thresholds, and compliance status. Essential for resource adequacy planning and FERC capacity market reporting.'

This is the LIFECYCLE_STATUS category field for this TRANSACTION_HEADER entity.']

[ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: energy|ancillary|capacity|virtual|demand_response|export|import — promote to reference product]']

  created_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp when this energy bid record was first created in the internal system (Silver Layer). Represents the RECORD_AUDIT_CREATED category. May differ from submission_timestamp if the bid was staged internally before submission.']
  fuel_type varchar [note: 'The primary fuel or energy source type of the generating resource associated with this bid. Used for regulatory reporting (EPA, DOE), Renewable Portfolio Standard (RPS) compliance tracking, and Greenhouse Gas (GHG) emissions accounting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: natural_gas|coal|nuclear|hydro|wind|solar|oil|storage|geothermal|biomass|other — promote to reference product]']

  interval_start_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Precise start timestamp of the bid interval, supporting sub-hourly (e.g., 5-minute or 15-minute) market intervals used in RTM and some ancillary service markets. Provides finer granularity than operating_hour for real-time and sub-hourly market participation.']
  lmp_congestion_component decimal(10,4) [note: 'The congestion component of the Locational Marginal Price (LMP) in $/MWh, reflecting transmission congestion costs at the pricing node. A negative value indicates the node benefits from congestion (sink node). Used for transmission planning and congestion cost analysis.']
  lmp_energy_component decimal(10,4) [note: 'The energy component of the Locational Marginal Price (LMP) in $/MWh, representing the system marginal cost of energy at the pricing node. LMP is decomposed into energy, congestion, and loss components per FERC and RTO/ISO settlement rules. Used for granular settlement analysis and IRP cost modeling.']
  lmp_loss_component decimal(10,4) [note: 'The marginal loss component of the Locational Marginal Price (LMP) in $/MWh, reflecting the cost of transmission losses at the pricing node. Used with energy and congestion components to reconcile total LMP for settlement and cost allocation.']
  market_submission_deadline timestamp [note: 'The RTO/ISO-defined deadline timestamp by which bids must be submitted for the target operating date and market type. Used to assess whether the bid was submitted on time and for compliance monitoring against market participation rules.']
  market_type varchar [note: 'Identifies whether this bid was submitted to the Day-Ahead Market (DAM) or Real-Time Market (RTM). DAM bids are submitted the prior day for next-day scheduling; RTM bids are submitted for the current operating hour or interval. Core classification for market settlement and reporting.']
  maximum_capacity_mw decimal(10,3) [note: 'The maximum generation or load capacity in Megawatts (MW) available for this bid. Represents the upper physical limit of the resource\'s capability for the bid interval. Must not exceed the resource\'s registered capacity with the RTO/ISO.']
  minimum_load_mw decimal(10,3) [note: 'The minimum generation output in Megawatts (MW) that the resource must operate at if committed by the market. Reflects the physical operating constraint of the generating unit (e.g., minimum stable load for a thermal unit). Used in unit commitment optimization and market clearing algorithms.']
  must_run_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the resource associated with this bid has a must-run designation (True), meaning it must be dispatched for reliability or contractual reasons regardless of economic merit. Must-run status affects market clearing and settlement treatment by the RTO/ISO.']
  no_load_cost_usd_per_hr decimal(10,2) [note: 'The fixed operating cost in US dollars per hour incurred when the generating unit is online but producing at zero or minimum output. Submitted as part of the bid for unit commitment cost optimization by the RTO/ISO. Confidential as it reflects internal cost structure.']
  notes varchar [note: 'Free-text field for operational notes, comments, or annotations related to this bid. May include reasons for bid amendments, special dispatch instructions, or coordination notes with the RTO/ISO or internal trading desk. Not used for structured data.']
  operating_date date [note: 'The calendar date for which the energy bid is intended to deliver or consume energy. For DAM bids, this is the next-day operating date. For RTM bids, this is the current operating date. Used for scheduling, settlement, and regulatory reporting alignment.']
  operating_hour varchar [note: 'The hour-ending (HE) or hour-beginning (HB) interval of the operating date for which this bid applies. Expressed as an integer 1–24 (or 0–23 depending on RTO/ISO convention). Used in conjunction with operating_date to identify the specific scheduling interval.']
  ramp_rate_mw_per_min decimal(8,3) [note: 'The rate at which the generating resource can increase or decrease output, expressed in Megawatts per minute (MW/min). Submitted as part of the bid to inform the RTO/ISO\'s unit commitment and dispatch optimization. Critical for ancillary service eligibility and real-time dispatch.']
  rec_eligible_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the energy associated with this bid is eligible to generate Renewable Energy Certificates (RECs) under applicable state Renewable Portfolio Standard (RPS) programs. True for qualifying renewable resources (wind, solar, hydro, etc.). Used for RPS compliance tracking and REC inventory management.']
  rejection_reason_code varchar [note: 'The reason code or message returned by the RTO/ISO when a bid is rejected or partially accepted. Null for accepted bids. Used for operational troubleshooting, bid strategy refinement, and regulatory compliance review. Values are RTO/ISO-specific and may vary by market operator.']
  rto_confirmation_number varchar [note: 'The confirmation or acknowledgment number returned by the RTO/ISO system upon successful receipt of the bid submission. Serves as the external system receipt reference for audit and dispute resolution purposes.']
  rto_iso_code varchar [note: 'Code identifying the Regional Transmission Organization (RTO) or Independent System Operator (ISO) to which this bid was submitted. Determines the applicable market rules, tariff, and settlement procedures. Essential for multi-RTO utilities operating across market boundaries. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: PJM|MISO|CAISO|NYISO|ISONE|SPP|ERCOT — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]']
  self_schedule_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this bid is a self-schedule (True) or an economic bid (False). Self-schedules are submitted at a price that ensures dispatch regardless of market clearing price (e.g., must-run or must-take resources such as nuclear or contracted renewables). Economic bids compete on price in the market.']
  settlement_amount_usd decimal(14,2) [note: 'The calculated settlement value in US dollars for this bid, derived from cleared_quantity_mw multiplied by cleared_price_per_mwh for the interval. Represents the financial obligation or revenue for this bid record. Confidential as it reflects wholesale market financial exposure. Supports FERC market-based rate reporting and revenue management.']
  startup_cost_usd decimal(12,2) [note: 'The cost in US dollars to start up the generating unit from cold, warm, or hot state, as submitted in the bid. Used by the RTO/ISO in unit commitment optimization to determine the economic dispatch order. Confidential as it reflects internal cost structure.']
  submission_timestamp timestamp [note: 'The date and time when the bid or offer was submitted to the RTO/ISO market system. Represents the principal real-world business event time (BUSINESS_EVENT_TIMESTAMP category). Stored in ISO 8601 format with timezone offset. Critical for market deadline compliance and audit trail.']
  updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp when this energy bid record was last modified in the internal system. Represents the RECORD_AUDIT_UPDATED category. Tracks amendments, status updates, or corrections applied after initial creation.']

  Note: 'Transactional record capturing individual energy bids and offers submitted to RTO/ISO day-ahead market (DAM) and real-time market (RTM). Stores bid type (energy, ancillary), resource ID, pricing node reference, bid interval (hourly or sub-hourly), bid price ($/MWh), bid quantity (MW), bid curve segments, market (DAM/RTM), submission timestamp, and acceptance/rejection status from the RTO/ISO. Core operational record for wholesale market participation. Note: virtual transactions (INCs/DECs/UTCs) may be captured here as a bid type in MVM scope but warrant a dedicated product at ECM scope for distinct lifecycle and settlement treatment.'
}

Table market.dispatch_award {
  dispatch_award_id varchar [pk, note: 'Unique surrogate identifier for each dispatch award record in the Silver layer lakehouse. Primary key for the dispatch_award data product. Entity role: TRANSACTION_HEADER — represents a discrete RTO/ISO market clearing event awarding a generation unit a scheduled MW commitment for a specific market interval.']
  capacity_obligation_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the capacity market obligation (e.g., PJM RPM, MISO Planning Resource Auction) associated with this dispatch award, if applicable. Links energy dispatch awards to capacity commitments for resource adequacy compliance and IRP reporting. Null if no capacity obligation applies.']
  cost_center_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Dispatch operations are managed by specific departments (generation operations, trading desk) with cost accountability for fuel, O&M, and operational expenses. Enables cost allocation and profitabilit']
  energy_bid_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the originating market bid or offer submitted by the utility to the RTO/ISO that resulted in this dispatch award. Links the award back to the bid strategy and offer parameters for settlement verification and FERC market-based rate compliance auditing.']
  fuel_delivery_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to supply.fuel_delivery. Business justification: Real-time dispatch decisions require fuel availability confirmation. Links generation dispatch awards to actual fuel deliveries for operational reconciliation, heat rate validation, cost-to-serve calc']
  generating_unit_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the generation asset (power plant unit) awarded this dispatch schedule. Links the market award to the physical generation resource in the asset management system (Oracle WAM or IBM Maximo). Serves as the PARTY_REFERENCE / MASTER_RESOURCE link for this transaction.']
  master_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to asset.asset_master. Business justification: Dispatch awards must link to physical generation asset for operational coordination with maintenance schedules, validation of dispatch feasibility against asset status, actual generation measurement v']
  participant_registration_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the registered market participant entity (Power and Utilities or its trading subsidiary) that submitted the bid and received this dispatch award from the RTO/ISO. Required for FERC market-based rate authority tracking and settlement reconciliation.']
  ppa_contract_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the Power Purchase Agreement (PPA) contract position associated with this dispatch award, if the generation is sourced from a contracted third-party resource. Links wholesale procurement contracts to awarded dispatch schedules for contract position management and FERC market-based rate compliance. Null for utility-owned generation.']
  pricing_node_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the RTO/ISO pricing node (bus or aggregate node) at which the Locational Marginal Price (LMP) is calculated for this dispatch award. Determines the settlement price applicable to the awarded MW schedule. Critical for LMP-based revenue settlement.']
  rto_iso_id varchar [note: 'FK to market.rto_iso']
  ancillary_service_mw decimal(12,4) [note: 'The Megawatt (MW) capacity awarded for ancillary service obligations (e.g., spinning reserve, regulation) associated with this dispatch award. Distinct from scheduled_mw which represents energy dispatch. Null or zero when ancillary_service_type is NONE. Used for NERC reliability compliance and RTO/ISO ancillary service settlement.']
  ancillary_service_type varchar [note: 'Identifies whether this dispatch award includes an ancillary service obligation in addition to or instead of energy dispatch. NONE = energy-only dispatch; REG_UP = regulation up (frequency regulation upward); REG_DOWN = regulation down; SPIN_RES = spinning reserve; NON_SPIN_RES = non-spinning reserve; VOLT_SUPPORT = voltage support / reactive power. Required for FERC ancillary services tariff compliance and NERC reliability standard reporting.']
  award_reference_number varchar [note: 'Externally-known transaction identifier assigned by the RTO/ISO market clearing system (e.g., CAISO, PJM, MISO) for this specific dispatch instruction or schedule award. Used for reconciliation with RTO/ISO settlement statements and FERC market-based rate filings. Maps to the dispatch instruction ID in ABB or GE Energy Management System.']
  award_status varchar [note: 'Current lifecycle state of the dispatch award. AWARDED = RTO/ISO has cleared and issued the dispatch instruction; CONFIRMED = generation unit operator has acknowledged the award; EXECUTING = unit is actively generating per the schedule; COMPLETED = interval has passed and generation was delivered; CANCELLED = award was rescinded prior to execution; SUPERSEDED = replaced by a revised dispatch instruction in the same interval.']
  award_version_number varchar [note: 'Sequential version number for this dispatch award record, incremented each time the RTO/ISO issues a revised dispatch instruction for the same generation unit and interval. Version 1 is the initial award; higher versions represent resettlements or corrections. Used to identify the most current award and track instruction revisions.']
  commitment_status varchar [note: 'Indicates how the generation unit was committed for this dispatch award. COMMITTED = unit was committed by the RTO/ISO through the market clearing process; DECOMMITTED = unit was previously committed but released; SELF_SCHEDULED = utility submitted a self-schedule outside the competitive market; MUST_RUN = unit designated as must-run by the RTO/ISO for reliability; RELIABILITY_MUST_RUN = unit committed for reliability reasons outside normal market dispatch.']
  created_timestamp timestamp [note: 'The date and time when this dispatch award record was first captured in the Silver layer lakehouse, reflecting when the RTO/ISO market clearing result was ingested from the source system (ABB or GE EMS / RTO/ISO market interface). Audit timestamp for data lineage and ETL reconciliation. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.']
  dispatch_instruction_timestamp timestamp [note: 'The precise date and time (in ISO 8601 format with timezone offset) at which the RTO/ISO issued the dispatch instruction or schedule award to the generation unit operator. This is the principal business event timestamp for the transaction. Used for real-time operations coordination with SCADA/EMS and for FERC compliance audit trails. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.']
  economic_max_mw decimal(12,4) [note: 'The maximum Megawatt (MW) output level at which the generation unit can operate economically, as submitted in the unit\'s market offer and recognized in this dispatch award. Defines the upper bound of the unit\'s dispatchable operating range. Used by the RTO/ISO dispatch algorithm and SCADA/EMS for real-time control.']
  economic_min_mw decimal(12,4) [note: 'The minimum Megawatt (MW) output level at which the generation unit can operate economically, as submitted in the unit\'s market offer and recognized in this dispatch award. Defines the lower bound of the unit\'s dispatchable operating range. Used by the RTO/ISO dispatch algorithm and SCADA/EMS for real-time control.']
  ems_dispatch_confirmation_code varchar [note: 'The confirmation or acknowledgment identifier generated by the ABB or GE Energy Management System (EMS) when the dispatch instruction was received and confirmed for execution. Provides the audit trail linking the market award to the real-time SCADA/EMS dispatch execution record. Used for operations coordination and post-event reliability analysis.']
  fuel_type varchar [note: 'The primary fuel type used by the generation unit for this dispatch award. Drives heat rate calculations, fuel cost recovery (Fuel Adjustment Clause / FAC), emissions reporting to EPA, and RPS compliance tracking. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: NATURAL_GAS|COAL|NUCLEAR|HYDRO|WIND|SOLAR|OIL|BIOMASS|GEOTHERMAL|STORAGE|CHP — promote to reference product]']
  generation_technology varchar [note: 'The generation technology classification of the dispatched unit. CT = Combustion Turbine; CC = Combined Cycle; STEAM = steam turbine (coal/gas/nuclear); HYDRO = hydroelectric; WIND = wind turbine; SOLAR_PV = photovoltaic; SOLAR_THERMAL = concentrating solar; STORAGE = battery or pumped hydro storage. Used for IRP resource adequacy modeling and FERC EQR reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: CT|CC|STEAM|NUCLEAR|HYDRO|WIND|SOLAR_PV|SOLAR_THERMAL|STORAGE|CHP|GEOTHERMAL — promote to reference product]']
  ghg_emissions_rate_lbs_per_mwh decimal(10,4) [note: 'The greenhouse gas (GHG) CO2-equivalent emissions rate in pounds per Megawatt-Hour (lbs/MWh) for the generation unit at this dispatch level. Used for EPA GHG compliance reporting, state environmental regulatory filings, and corporate sustainability accounting. Null for zero-emission resources.']
  heat_rate_btu_per_kwh decimal(10,2) [note: 'The thermal efficiency of the generation unit expressed as British Thermal Units (BTU) consumed per kilowatt-hour (kWh) of electricity generated, as applicable to this dispatch award. Used for fuel cost calculation, Fuel Adjustment Clause (FAC) recovery, EPA GHG emissions estimation, and IRP resource modeling. Applicable to thermal units; null for renewables.']
  interval_duration_minutes varchar [note: 'Duration of the dispatch interval in minutes. Typical values are 5 (RTM five-minute dispatch), 15 (15-minute market), or 60 (DAM hourly schedule). Drives MW-to-MWh energy quantity calculations for settlement and generation accounting.']
  interval_end_timestamp timestamp [note: 'End date and time of the market dispatch interval for which the MW schedule is awarded. Defines the close of the operating window. For RTM typically 5 minutes after interval_start_timestamp; for DAM typically 60 minutes after. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.']
  interval_start_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Start date and time of the market dispatch interval for which the MW schedule is awarded. For RTM this is typically a 5-minute interval; for DAM this is typically an hourly interval. Combined with interval_end_timestamp defines the precise operating window. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.']
  is_reliability_dispatch boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this dispatch award was issued for reliability reasons (True) rather than economic dispatch (False). Reliability dispatches may occur outside normal market clearing to maintain grid stability per NERC reliability standards. Affects cost recovery treatment and FERC compliance reporting.']
  is_renewable boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the dispatched generation unit qualifies as a renewable resource (True) under applicable state Renewable Portfolio Standard (RPS) or federal definitions. Drives Renewable Energy Certificate (REC) tracking, RPS compliance reporting to state PUCs, and GHG emissions accounting.']
  is_self_scheduled boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the generation unit was self-scheduled by the utility (True) rather than dispatched through the competitive market clearing process (False). Self-scheduled units are committed at the utility\'s discretion outside the RTO/ISO economic dispatch stack. Affects settlement treatment and FERC market-based rate reporting.']
  lmp_congestion_component_usd_per_mwh decimal(14,4) [note: 'The congestion component of the Locational Marginal Price (LMP) in USD/MWh, reflecting the cost of transmission constraints between the pricing node and the reference bus. Negative values indicate the node benefits from congestion. Critical for transmission planning and FERC OATT compliance analysis.']
  lmp_energy_component_usd_per_mwh decimal(14,4) [note: 'The energy component of the Locational Marginal Price (LMP) in USD/MWh, representing the system-wide marginal cost of energy at the reference bus. One of three LMP components (energy, congestion, loss) published by the RTO/ISO. Used for granular settlement analysis and IRP resource adequacy modeling.']
  lmp_loss_component_usd_per_mwh decimal(14,4) [note: 'The marginal loss component of the Locational Marginal Price (LMP) in USD/MWh, reflecting the incremental cost of transmission losses between the pricing node and the reference bus. Used for settlement reconciliation and transmission loss accounting per FERC OATT requirements.']
  lmp_usd_per_mwh decimal(14,4) [note: 'The Locational Marginal Price (LMP) in US Dollars per Megawatt-Hour ($/MWh) at the associated pricing node for this dispatch interval, as published by the RTO/ISO following market clearing. Composed of energy, congestion, and loss components. Primary settlement price for the awarded MW schedule. Sensitive market pricing data.']
  market_type varchar [note: 'Identifies the wholesale energy market in which this dispatch award was cleared. DAM = Day-Ahead Market; RTM = Real-Time Market; HASP = Hour-Ahead Scheduling Process; RUC = Reliability Unit Commitment; CAISO_15MIN = 15-Minute Market. Determines settlement rules and pricing methodology applicable to the award. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: DAM|RTM|HASP|RUC|CAISO_15MIN|ELMP|SCED — promote to reference product]']
  no_load_cost_usd_per_hr decimal(14,4) [note: 'The fixed operating cost in US Dollars per hour ($/hr) incurred to keep the generation unit synchronized and online at zero net output, as submitted in the market offer. Recovered through RTO/ISO no-load cost compensation. Sensitive commercial cost data used in IRP and FERC rate case filings.']
  operating_date date [note: 'The calendar date (in the RTO/ISO operating day definition, typically midnight-to-midnight local prevailing time) on which this dispatch award is scheduled to be executed. Used for daily settlement reconciliation, IRP resource adequacy reporting, and FERC EQR filings. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.']
  ramp_rate_down_mw_per_min decimal(10,4) [note: 'The maximum rate in Megawatts per minute (MW/min) at which the generation unit can decrease its output, as recognized in this dispatch award. Constrains how quickly the unit can respond to downward dispatch instructions. Used for SCADA/EMS real-time control and RTO/ISO reliability dispatch.']
  ramp_rate_up_mw_per_min decimal(10,4) [note: 'The maximum rate in Megawatts per minute (MW/min) at which the generation unit can increase its output, as recognized in this dispatch award. Constrains how quickly the unit can respond to upward dispatch instructions from the RTO/ISO or SCADA/EMS. Critical for frequency regulation and ancillary services compliance.']
  rec_quantity decimal(12,4) [note: 'The number of Renewable Energy Certificates (RECs) generated or associated with this dispatch award, where one REC represents one MWh of renewable electricity generation. Applicable only when is_renewable = True. Used for RPS compliance tracking, REC registry reporting, and state PUC regulatory filings.']
  scheduled_mw decimal(12,4) [note: 'The awarded generation output in Megawatts (MW) that the generation unit is scheduled to produce during the dispatch interval, as determined by the RTO/ISO market clearing engine. This is the primary quantitative fact of the dispatch award. Used for real-time SCADA/EMS dispatch execution, settlement, and NERC reliability compliance.']
  settlement_amount_usd decimal(16,2) [note: 'The gross settlement amount in US Dollars ($) for this dispatch award, calculated as scheduled_mw × (interval_duration_minutes / 60) × lmp_usd_per_mwh plus applicable start-up and no-load cost recovery. Represents the revenue or cost obligation for the awarded interval. Used for financial settlement reconciliation with the RTO/ISO and GAAP revenue recognition.']
  startup_cost_usd decimal(14,2) [note: 'The total start-up cost in US Dollars ($) associated with committing this generation unit for the dispatch award, as submitted in the market offer. Includes fuel, labor, and equipment costs incurred to bring the unit from cold/warm/hot standby to minimum load. Recovered through RTO/ISO start-up cost compensation mechanisms. Sensitive commercial cost data.']
  updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'The date and time when this dispatch award record was last modified in the Silver layer lakehouse, such as when a revised dispatch instruction or settlement correction was applied. Used for change data capture, audit trails, and SOX compliance. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.']

  Note: 'Transactional record for generation unit dispatch schedules and commitment instructions awarded by the RTO/ISO following DAM and RTM market clearing. Captures scheduled MW by interval (5-minute or hourly), operating point (economic minimum/maximum), ramp rate limits, unit commitment status (committed, decommitted, self-scheduled), start-up cost ($), no-load cost ($/hr), associated LMP pricing node, and dispatch instruction timestamp. Links generation assets to their awarded market schedules and supports real-time operations coordination with SCADA/EMS for dispatch execution.'
}

Table market.lmp_price {
  lmp_price_id varchar [pk, note: 'Unique surrogate identifier for each LMP price record in the silver layer. Primary key for the lmp_price data product. Entity role: TRANSACTION_HEADER — represents a discrete published price event from the RTO/ISO for a specific pricing node and settlement interval.']
  lmp_pricing_node_id varchar [note: 'FK to market.pricing_node']
  primary_lmp_pricing_node_id varchar [note: 'Reference identifier for the pricing node (pnode) at which the LMP is published by the RTO/ISO. A pnode represents a specific electrical bus or aggregation point on the transmission grid where energy prices are calculated. Used to join to the pnode master reference for geographic and network context.']
  congestion_component_per_mwh decimal(18,6) [note: 'The congestion component of the LMP in US dollars per megawatt-hour ($/MWh), reflecting the cost of transmission congestion at this pricing node relative to the reference bus. A positive value indicates the node is import-constrained; a negative value indicates export-constrained. Critical for transmission congestion management and FTR/CRR hedging analysis.']
  congestion_direction varchar [note: 'Indicates the direction of transmission congestion affecting this pricing node: IMPORT (node is import-constrained, positive congestion component), EXPORT (node is export-constrained, negative congestion component), or UNCONSTRAINED (no binding transmission constraint). Supports FTR/CRR portfolio management and transmission congestion hedging strategy.']
  control_area_code varchar [note: 'Code identifying the Balancing Authority Area (BAA) or control area within which this pricing node is located, as defined by NERC. Used for inter-area settlement, OATT compliance reporting, and NERC reliability reporting.']
  created_timestamp timestamp [note: 'The date and time when this LMP price record was first ingested and created in the Databricks silver layer data product, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Supports data lineage, audit trail, and ETL pipeline monitoring.']
  currency_code varchar [note: 'Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the LMP price values (e.g., USD for US Dollar, CAD for Canadian Dollar for cross-border markets). Ensures unambiguous interpretation of all monetary price components in multi-currency market contexts.']
  data_feed_code varchar [note: 'Code identifying the specific RTO/ISO data feed, API endpoint, or file type from which this LMP record was sourced (e.g., PJM_DA_LMP, CAISO_RTM_LMP_5MIN). Supports data lineage tracking, feed monitoring, and troubleshooting of price data gaps or anomalies.']
  energy_component_per_mwh decimal(18,6) [note: 'The energy component of the LMP in US dollars per megawatt-hour ($/MWh), representing the system-wide marginal cost of energy at the reference bus. This component is uniform across all nodes in the market and reflects the cost of the marginal generating unit dispatched to serve load.']
  interval_duration_minutes varchar [note: 'Duration of the settlement interval in minutes (e.g., 60 for hourly DAM, 5 for RTM 5-minute intervals, 15 for 15-minute RTM intervals). Enables correct MWh energy quantity calculations when multiplying power (MW) by interval duration.']
  interval_end_timestamp timestamp [note: 'The end date and time of the settlement interval for which this LMP is applicable, in ISO 8601 format with timezone offset (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Together with interval_start_timestamp, defines the precise settlement window. Used to validate interval completeness and detect gaps in price data.']
  interval_start_timestamp timestamp [note: 'The start date and time of the settlement interval for which this LMP is applicable, in ISO 8601 format with timezone offset (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). For DAM, this is typically the top of the hour; for RTM, this may be a 5-minute or 15-minute interval start. Foundational for interval-level settlement and congestion analysis.']
  is_binding_constraint boolean [note: 'Indicates whether a transmission constraint was binding during this settlement interval at or affecting this pricing node (True = binding constraint active; False = no binding constraint). A binding constraint causes non-zero congestion component values and is critical for transmission congestion management and FTR/CRR settlement analysis.']
  is_holiday boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the operating date falls on a recognized market holiday as defined by the RTO/ISO or applicable tariff (True = holiday; False = non-holiday). Holiday periods typically follow off-peak pricing rules and affect demand response program eligibility and TOU rate calculations.']
  is_price_cap_applied boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the RTO/ISO applied a market price cap or floor to this LMP during the settlement interval (True = price cap or floor was applied; False = price cleared within normal bounds). Price caps are regulatory limits set by FERC to prevent market manipulation. Relevant for settlement dispute analysis and regulatory reporting.']
  lmp_total_per_mwh decimal(18,6) [note: 'The total Locational Marginal Price (LMP) in US dollars per megawatt-hour ($/MWh) for this pricing node and settlement interval, as published by the RTO/ISO. Equals the sum of the energy component, congestion component, and loss component. The primary price used for wholesale energy settlement calculations.']
  lmp_version varchar [note: 'Version label or identifier assigned by the RTO/ISO to distinguish between different published versions of LMP data for the same operating interval (e.g., \'v1\', \'v2\', or a timestamp-based version string). Used alongside revision_number to uniquely identify the authoritative price record for settlement and audit purposes.']
  load_zone_code varchar [note: 'The RTO/ISO-defined load zone or pricing zone code to which this pricing node belongs. Load zones aggregate individual bus nodes for zonal settlement and load-serving entity (LSE) obligations. Used for zonal LMP analysis, capacity market obligations, and TOU rate design.']
  loss_component_per_mwh decimal(18,6) [note: 'The marginal loss component of the LMP in US dollars per megawatt-hour ($/MWh), representing the cost of marginal transmission losses at this pricing node relative to the reference bus. Reflects the incremental cost of delivering an additional MWh to this node accounting for line losses.']
  market_day date [note: 'The market operating day (yyyy-MM-dd) as defined by the RTO/ISO, which may differ from the calendar date for intervals near midnight due to market day boundary conventions. Used for market settlement period alignment and day-ahead vs. real-time reconciliation.']
  market_type varchar [note: 'Identifies whether this LMP was published in the Day-Ahead Market (DAM) or the Real-Time Market (RTM). DAM prices are forward-looking hourly prices cleared the day before delivery; RTM prices are five-minute or hourly prices cleared during the operating hour. Critical for settlement calculations and hedging analysis.']
  operating_date date [note: 'The calendar date (yyyy-MM-dd) of the operating day to which this LMP belongs. Used for daily aggregation, settlement period alignment, and day-ahead vs. real-time comparison reporting. Derived from interval_start_timestamp but stored explicitly for query performance.']
  operating_hour varchar [note: 'The hour ending (HE) of the operating day (1–24) to which this settlement interval belongs. Standard RTO/ISO convention for identifying the delivery hour. Used for hourly aggregation, TOU rate alignment, and peak/off-peak classification.']
  peak_period_type varchar [note: 'Classification of the settlement interval into a peak period category based on the applicable tariff or market definition: ON_PEAK (high-demand hours, typically weekday daytime), OFF_PEAK (low-demand hours, nights and weekends), SUPER_PEAK (highest demand hours for CPP or TOU rates), or SHOULDER (transitional hours). Used for TOU rate analysis, demand response program evaluation, and IRP resource adequacy studies.']
  price_cap_type varchar [note: 'Type of price cap or floor applied to this LMP when is_price_cap_applied is True. OFFER_CAP indicates the offer cap was binding; PRICE_FLOOR indicates the minimum price floor was applied; SCARCITY_PRICING indicates emergency scarcity pricing was triggered; NONE indicates no cap was applied. Used for market monitoring and regulatory reporting to FERC.']
  price_quality_flag varchar [note: 'Data quality indicator for this LMP record as assessed by the utility\'s market data management or EMS platform. VALID = price passed all validation checks; SUSPECT = price flagged for review due to anomalous value; INVALID = price failed validation and should not be used for settlement; ESTIMATED = price was estimated due to missing source data; MISSING = no price was received for this interval.']
  price_status varchar [note: 'Lifecycle status of this LMP price record indicating its settlement finality. PRELIMINARY prices are published shortly after the interval; FINAL prices are the binding settlement values after RTO/ISO validation; REVISED prices reflect corrections to previously published values; ESTIMATED prices are used when actual data is unavailable. Drives which records are used in financial settlement.']
  publish_timestamp timestamp [note: 'The date and time when the RTO/ISO officially published or released this LMP price record, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Represents the business event time of price publication. Used to track data latency, validate timeliness of price feeds, and support audit trails for settlement disputes.']
  revision_number varchar [note: 'Sequential revision number assigned by the RTO/ISO or the utility\'s MDMS/market system to track successive corrections to a published LMP for the same pnode and interval. A value of 0 or 1 indicates the initial publication; higher values indicate subsequent revisions. Used to identify the most current authoritative price for settlement.']
  rto_iso_code varchar [note: 'Code identifying the Regional Transmission Organization (RTO) or Independent System Operator (ISO) that published this LMP. Determines the market rules, settlement procedures, and tariff framework applicable to this price record. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: PJM|CAISO|MISO|NYISO|ISONE|ERCOT|SPP — promote to reference product]']
  season_code varchar [note: 'Seasonal classification of the operating date for this LMP record (SUMMER, WINTER, SPRING, FALL) based on the utility\'s or RTO/ISO\'s tariff-defined seasonal boundaries. Used for seasonal price analysis, capacity market seasonal obligations, and IRP resource adequacy modeling.']
  settlement_period varchar [note: 'Identifies the settlement billing period in which this LMP is used: INITIAL (first pass settlement shortly after the operating day), FINAL (binding settlement after all data is validated, typically 60 days post-operating day), or RESETTLEMENT (corrected settlement due to data errors or disputes). Determines which price version is used in financial settlement statements.']
  source_system_record_code varchar [note: 'The native record identifier assigned by the source RTO/ISO market system or the utility\'s market data management platform (e.g., ABB or GE Energy Management System, or the RTO/ISO API response record ID). Enables traceability back to the originating system for audit, reconciliation, and dispute resolution purposes.']
  updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'The date and time when this LMP price record was last modified in the Databricks silver layer, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Updated when price revisions, quality flag changes, or settlement period reclassifications are applied. Supports change tracking and audit compliance.']

  Note: 'Transactional record storing Locational Marginal Prices (LMP) published by the RTO/ISO for each pricing node (pnode) and settlement interval. Captures LMP components: energy component, congestion component, and loss component (all in $/MWh), market type (DAM/RTM), interval start/end timestamps, and pnode identifier. Foundational for settlement calculations, hedging analysis, and transmission congestion management.'
}

  rto_iso_id varchar [note: 'FK to market.rto_iso']
  vendor_invoice_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to supply.vendor_invoice. Business justification: Market settlements for tolling agreements, capacity payments, or generation services often correspond to vendor invoices. Enables three-way matching between market settlement, vendor invoice, and serv']
  ancillary_service_charges_usd decimal(18,4) [note: 'Charges for ancillary services procured from the RTO/ISO, including regulation, spinning reserve, non-spinning reserve, and reactive power. Supports O&M cost allocation and FERC Form 1 Schedule 321.']
  ancillary_service_credits_usd decimal(18,4) [note: 'Revenues received for ancillary services provided to the RTO/ISO, including regulation, spinning reserve, and demand response. Supports revenue disaggregation for FERC Form 1 and IRP analysis.']
  billing_period_end_date date [note: 'Last calendar date of the settlement billing period covered by this statement. Together with billing_period_start_date defines the settlement window for charge and credit line items.']
  billing_period_start_date date [note: 'First calendar date of the settlement billing period covered by this statement. For DAM/RTM, typically a single operating day; for capacity markets, may span a month or season.']
  capacity_charges_usd decimal(18,4) [note: 'Charges assessed for capacity market obligations, including capacity deficiency penalties or capacity purchases from the RTO/ISO capacity auction. Supports resource adequacy cost tracking for IRP filings.']
  capacity_credits_usd decimal(18,4) [note: 'Revenues received for capacity resources cleared in the RTO/ISO capacity auction. Supports resource adequacy revenue tracking and PPA valuation for IRP filings.']
  congestion_credits_usd decimal(18,4) [note: 'Credits received from Congestion Revenue Rights (CRR) or Financial Transmission Rights (FTR) held by the market participant, offsetting congestion costs in the LMP settlement. Supports hedging effectiveness analysis.']
  created_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp when this settlement statement record was first ingested into the Databricks Silver Layer from the source RTO/ISO system or internal market operations system. Supports data lineage and audit trail.']
  currency_code varchar [note: 'Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts on this settlement statement. Typically \'USD\' for North American RTO/ISO markets. Included to support multi-currency scenarios for cross-border markets (e.g., IESO in Canada).']
  dispute_amount_usd decimal(18,4) [note: 'Dollar amount under formal dispute with the RTO/ISO for this settlement statement. May be a subset of the net_settlement_amount_usd. Populated only when is_disputed = True. Supports contingent liability disclosure for SOX and GAAP.']
  dispute_deadline_date date [note: 'Last calendar date by which the market participant may file a formal dispute or request for resettlement with the RTO/ISO for this statement. Derived from RTO/ISO tariff dispute windows; tracked to prevent forfeiture of dispute rights.']
  energy_charges_usd decimal(18,4) [note: 'Portion of total charges attributable to energy (MWh) purchases in the DAM or RTM, settled at Locational Marginal Price (LMP). Supports disaggregated cost analysis for IRP and FERC EQR reporting.']
  energy_credits_usd decimal(18,4) [note: 'Portion of total credits attributable to energy (MWh) sales in the DAM or RTM, settled at Locational Marginal Price (LMP). Supports revenue disaggregation for IRP and FERC EQR reporting.']
  ferc_account_code varchar [note: 'FERC Uniform System of Accounts (USofA) account code applicable to this settlement statement (e.g., Account 555 for Purchased Power, Account 447 for Sales for Resale). Required for FERC Form 1 and EQR regulatory reporting.']
  is_disputed boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the utility has filed a formal dispute with the RTO/ISO for this settlement statement. True = active dispute filed; False = no dispute. Triggers dispute tracking workflow and suspends payment processing for disputed amounts.']
  market_type varchar [note: 'Classifies the wholesale market segment covered by this settlement statement. DAM = Day-Ahead Market; RTM = Real-Time Market; capacity = capacity obligation market; ancillary_services = regulation, spinning reserve, etc.; transmission = transmission congestion or OATT charges. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: DAM|RTM|capacity|ancillary_services|transmission|REC — promote to reference product if additional market types are added]']
  net_settlement_amount_usd decimal(18,4) [note: 'Net financial obligation for this settlement statement in US dollars, calculated as total_credits_usd minus total_charges_usd. A positive value indicates a net receipt (credit to utility); a negative value indicates a net payment owed to the RTO/ISO. Primary figure for treasury and FERC Form 1 reporting.']
  notes varchar [note: 'Free-text field for market operations staff to record internal annotations, reconciliation observations, or dispute correspondence references associated with this settlement statement. Not transmitted to the RTO/ISO.']
  operating_day date [note: 'The specific RTO/ISO operating day (midnight-to-midnight) to which this settlement statement applies. For DAM and RTM settlements, this is a single calendar date. For multi-day statements (capacity, ancillary), this field represents the primary operating day or is set to the billing_period_start_date.']
  payment_date date [note: 'Actual calendar date on which payment was made to or received from the RTO/ISO for this settlement statement. Distinct from payment_due_date; used to calculate late payment penalties and for cash flow reconciliation.']
  payment_due_date date [note: 'Calendar date by which the net settlement amount must be paid to or received from the RTO/ISO. Drives cash flow forecasting, treasury operations, and late-payment penalty exposure.']
  payment_transaction_ref varchar [note: 'External payment transaction reference number or ACH/wire transfer confirmation number associated with the settlement of this statement. Populated upon payment execution. Supports treasury reconciliation with SAP S/4HANA accounts payable/receivable.']
  resettlement_reason varchar [note: 'Free-text or coded description of the reason for resettlement or true-up, as provided by the RTO/ISO. Examples include meter data correction, LMP recalculation, capacity obligation adjustment, or ancillary service reallocation. Populated only for statement_run_type values of \'resettlement\' or \'true_up\'.']
  source_system_code varchar [note: 'Code identifying the operational system of record from which this settlement statement was sourced. \'RTO_ISO_PORTAL\' = direct RTO/ISO market portal feed; \'EMS\' = ABB or GE Energy Management System; \'ERP\' = SAP S/4HANA or Oracle ERP Cloud; \'MANUAL\' = manually entered by market operations staff.']
  statement_number varchar [note: 'Externally-known alphanumeric identifier assigned by the RTO/ISO to uniquely identify this settlement statement. Used for reconciliation with the RTO/ISO portal and FERC EQR filings.']
  statement_publication_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Date and time when the RTO/ISO published and made this settlement statement available to market participants. This is the principal real-world business event timestamp — the moment the financial obligation became known to the utility.']
  statement_run_type varchar [note: 'Indicates the settlement run cycle that produced this statement. \'initial\' is the first pass estimate; \'resettlement\' reflects corrections after initial; \'true_up\' applies final meter data adjustments; \'final\' is the binding, non-revisable settlement. Drives financial posting and dispute eligibility windows.']
  statement_status varchar [note: 'Current lifecycle state of the settlement statement within the utility\'s internal reconciliation workflow. \'published\' = received from RTO/ISO; \'under_review\' = internal validation in progress; \'disputed\' = formal dispute filed with RTO/ISO; \'accepted\' = validated and approved for payment; \'paid\' = payment executed; \'closed\' = fully settled and archived.']
  statement_version varchar [note: 'Sequential version number of the settlement statement issued by the RTO/ISO for the same billing period and run type. Increments with each resettlement or correction. Version 1 is the original issuance.']
  total_charges_usd decimal(18,4) [note: 'Gross sum of all charge line items on this settlement statement in US dollars. Represents amounts owed by the market participant to the RTO/ISO for energy purchases, capacity obligations, ancillary service charges, and transmission fees.']
  total_credits_usd decimal(18,4) [note: 'Gross sum of all credit line items on this settlement statement in US dollars. Represents amounts owed to the market participant by the RTO/ISO for energy sales, capacity revenues, ancillary service revenues, and congestion credits.']
  total_energy_volume_mwh decimal(18,4) [note: 'Net energy volume in Megawatt-Hours (MWh) settled on this statement, representing the algebraic sum of all DAM and RTM energy positions. Positive = net purchase; negative = net sale. Supports FERC EQR quantity reporting.']
  transmission_charges_usd decimal(18,4) [note: 'Charges for transmission service, congestion, and OATT-related fees assessed on this settlement statement. Includes congestion component of LMP and transmission loss charges.']
  updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp when this settlement statement record was last modified in the Databricks Silver Layer, such as when a status change, dispute flag, or payment date was recorded. Supports change data capture and audit trail.']
  weighted_avg_lmp_usd_per_mwh decimal(10,4) [note: 'Volume-weighted average Locational Marginal Price (LMP) in USD per MWh across all energy positions settled on this statement. Supports market cost benchmarking, IRP analysis, and FERC EQR price reporting.']

  Note: 'Header-level transactional record for wholesale market settlement statements issued by the RTO/ISO covering DAM, RTM, capacity, and ancillary service charges and credits. Captures settlement run type (initial, resettlement, true-up, final), billing period, statement version number, total charges ($), total credits ($), net settlement amount, market participant ID, RTO/ISO identifier, payment due date, and statement publication date. Individual charge and credit details are decomposed in settlement_line_item. Serves as the SSOT for wholesale market financial settlement reconciliation and supports FERC EQR and Form 1 reporting.'
}

Table market.ancillary_service_award {
  ancillary_service_award_id varchar [pk, note: 'Unique surrogate identifier for each ancillary service award record in the Silver Layer lakehouse. Primary key for this transactional entity.']
  capacity_market_auction_id varchar [note: 'Identifier of the capacity market auction (e.g., PJM RPM, MISO Planning Resource Auction) associated with this award, if applicable. Populated for capacity-market-sourced ancillary obligations; null for DAM/RTM awards.']
  capacity_resource_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the generation unit, demand response resource, or storage asset that was awarded the ancillary service obligation. Links to the asset or resource master record.']
  master_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to asset.asset_master. Business justification: Ancillary service awards must link to physical asset providing regulation, spinning reserve, or other services for operational feasibility validation against asset capabilities, real-time performance ']
  participant_registration_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the utility\'s registered market participant entity that submitted the ancillary service offer and received this award from the RTO/ISO.']
  ppa_contract_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the Power Purchase Agreement (PPA) contract under which this ancillary service award is fulfilled, if the resource is a contracted third-party asset. Null for utility-owned resources.']
  pricing_node_id varchar [note: 'The RTO/ISO-assigned pricing node or location identifier (e.g., LMP node, pnode) associated with the resource providing the ancillary service. Used for Locational Marginal Price (LMP) settlement and transmission constraint analysis.']
  rto_iso_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the RTO/ISO entity (e.g., PJM, MISO, CAISO, ERCOT, NYISO, ISO-NE) that issued this ancillary service award. Serves as the PARTY_REFERENCE for this transaction.']
  award_reference_number varchar [note: 'Externally-known award confirmation number or transaction identifier assigned by the RTO/ISO for this ancillary service award. Used for reconciliation with RTO/ISO settlement statements and FERC compliance reporting.']
  award_status varchar [note: 'Current lifecycle state of the ancillary service award. \'awarded\' = RTO/ISO has issued the award; \'confirmed\' = utility has acknowledged; \'settled\' = financial settlement completed; \'disputed\' = under dispute resolution; \'cancelled\' = award rescinded; \'expired\' = obligation period elapsed without settlement.']
  award_timestamp timestamp [note: 'The date and time when the RTO/ISO issued the ancillary service award to the market participant. Represents the principal business event timestamp for this transaction record.']
  awarded_mw decimal(18,6) [note: 'The quantity of capacity in megawatts (MW) awarded by the RTO/ISO for the specified ancillary service type and operating interval. This is the primary quantitative fact of the award.']
  clearing_price_per_mw decimal(18,6) [note: 'The market clearing price in US dollars per megawatt ($/MW) at which the ancillary service was procured by the RTO/ISO. Used for settlement calculation and revenue recognition.']
  control_area_code varchar [note: 'Identifier for the balancing authority area or control area within the RTO/ISO footprint where the ancillary service obligation applies. Used for geographic segmentation of reliability obligations and NERC compliance reporting.']
  created_timestamp timestamp [note: 'The date and time when this ancillary service award record was first created in the data platform. Supports audit trail, data lineage, and Silver Layer ingestion tracking.']
  deployed_mw decimal(18,6) [note: 'Actual megawatts delivered by the resource during deployment events within the obligation period. May differ from awarded_mw if the resource was partially deployed or experienced a forced outage. Used for performance score calculation and NERC compliance.']
  deployment_event_count varchar [note: 'Number of times the ancillary service resource was actually deployed (called upon) by the RTO/ISO during the obligation period. A count of zero indicates the resource was held in reserve but not activated. Supports NERC reliability compliance reporting.']
  dispute_reference_number varchar [note: 'RTO/ISO or internal dispute tracking number if this award is under settlement dispute. Populated only when settlement_status is \'disputed\'. Supports dispute resolution workflow and FERC complaint tracking.']
  market_type varchar [note: 'Indicates whether the ancillary service award was procured in the Day-Ahead Market (DAM), Real-Time Market (RTM), or a forward capacity market auction.']
  nerc_compliance_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this ancillary service award and its associated performance met all applicable NERC reliability standards (e.g., BAL-001, BAL-002) for the obligation period. Used for NERC compliance reporting and audit trails.']
  net_settlement_amount decimal(18,2) [note: 'Final net settlement amount in US dollars after applying performance adjustments to the base settlement amount (settlement_amount + performance_adjustment_amount). Represents the actual revenue recognized for this award.']
  obligation_end_timestamp timestamp [note: 'The date and time when the ancillary service obligation period ends. Together with obligation_start_timestamp, defines the full obligation window for availability and performance measurement.']
  obligation_start_timestamp timestamp [note: 'The date and time when the ancillary service obligation period begins. Defines the start of the window during which the resource must be available and responsive.']
  offer_price_per_mw decimal(18,6) [note: 'The price in US dollars per megawatt ($/MW) at which the utility submitted its ancillary service offer into the market. Compared against clearing_price_per_mw for margin analysis and offer strategy review.']
  offered_mw decimal(18,6) [note: 'The quantity of capacity in megawatts (MW) that the utility originally offered into the ancillary service market. Compared against awarded_mw to assess offer acceptance rate and market clearing outcomes.']
  operating_date date [note: 'The calendar date on which the ancillary service obligation is to be performed. This is the principal real-world event date for the award, distinct from the award issuance timestamp.']
  operating_hour varchar [note: 'The hour-ending (HE) interval (1–24) within the operating date for which the ancillary service award applies. Used for sub-daily granularity in settlement and dispatch scheduling.']
  performance_adjustment_amount decimal(18,2) [note: 'Dollar adjustment applied to the base settlement amount based on the resource\'s performance score. Positive values indicate performance bonuses; negative values indicate penalties for under-performance. Required for FERC Order 755 pay-for-performance regulation compliance.']
  performance_score decimal(10,4) [note: 'Numeric performance score assigned by the RTO/ISO reflecting the resource\'s compliance with the ancillary service obligation during the operating interval. Scores typically range from 0.0 to 1.0 (or 0–100 per RTO convention). Impacts performance-based settlement adjustments and NERC compliance metrics.']
  rec_eligible_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the resource providing this ancillary service is eligible to generate Renewable Energy Certificates (RECs) for the energy delivered during deployment events. Supports RPS compliance tracking.']
  response_time_minutes decimal(10,2) [note: 'Actual response time in minutes from RTO/ISO dispatch signal to full MW delivery by the resource. Compared against the service type\'s required response time (e.g., 10 minutes for spinning reserve) for performance evaluation and NERC compliance.']
  service_type varchar [note: 'Classification of the ancillary service awarded by the RTO/ISO. Regulation up/down provides automatic generation control (AGC) response; spinning reserve is synchronized capacity available within 10 minutes; non-spinning reserve is offline capacity available within 10 minutes; voltage support and reactive power maintain grid voltage stability; black start enables grid restoration. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: regulation_up|regulation_down|spinning_reserve|non_spinning_reserve|voltage_support|black_start|reactive_power — promote to reference product]']
  settlement_amount decimal(18,2) [note: 'The gross settlement amount in US dollars payable to the utility for this ancillary service award, calculated as awarded_mw multiplied by clearing_price_per_mw for the obligation period. Supports ancillary service revenue tracking and FERC settlement reconciliation.']
  settlement_period varchar [note: 'The RTO/ISO-defined settlement period identifier (e.g., \'DAM-2024-01-15\', \'RTM-2024-01-15-HE14\') to which this award belongs. Used for batch settlement reconciliation and financial close processes.']
  settlement_status varchar [note: 'Current status of the financial settlement for this award. \'pending\' = awaiting RTO/ISO settlement run; \'preliminary\' = initial settlement issued; \'final\' = settlement finalized; \'resettled\' = corrected after initial settlement; \'disputed\' = under formal dispute with RTO/ISO.']
  source_system_award_code varchar [note: 'The native award identifier from the originating energy management or market operations system (e.g., ABB or GE Energy Management System, or RTO/ISO OASIS portal). Enables traceability back to the operational system of record for audit and reconciliation.']
  updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'The date and time when this ancillary service award record was last modified in the data platform, such as after a resettlement, performance score update, or dispute resolution.']

  Note: 'Transactional record for ancillary service awards received from the RTO/ISO, covering regulation (up/down), spinning reserve, non-spinning reserve, and voltage support. Captures service type, awarded MW, clearing price ($/MW), performance score, deployment events, and associated settlement amounts. Supports NERC reliability compliance and ancillary service revenue tracking.'
}

Business justification: REC inventory demonstrates renewable portfolio compliance in integrated resource plan filings. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: WECC|SERC|RFC|MRO|NPCC|TRE|FRCC — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]']
