  rec_status varchar [note: 'Current lifecycle status of the REC inventory position. \'available\' indicates RECs are unencumbered and eligible for use; \'retired\' indicates RECs have been permanently surrendered for compliance or voluntary claim; \'transferred\' indicates RECs have been sold or conveyed to another party; \'reserved\' indicates RECs are earmarked for a specific compliance obligation or transaction; \'pending\' indicates a registry transaction is in process; \'cancelled\' indicates RECs have been invalidated.']
  registry_platform varchar [note: 'The renewable energy certificate tracking registry platform in which this inventory position is recorded.   retirement_date date [note: 'The date on which these RECs were permanently retired in the registry for compliance or voluntary claim purposes. Populated only when rec_status is \'retired\'. Retirement is an irreversible registry action that prevents double-counting.']
  retirement_purpose varchar [note: 'The stated purpose for which these RECs were retired in the registry. \'rps_compliance\' for mandatory state RPS obligation fulfillment; \'voluntary_claim\' for voluntary renewable energy claims; \'green_tariff\' for utility green tariff program customers; \'net_energy_metering\' for NEM program accounting; \'other\' for miscellaneous retirement purposes.   rps_tier varchar [note: 'The RPS compliance tier classification for these RECs under the applicable state RPS program.   state_of_issuance varchar [note: 'The two-letter U.S. state postal abbreviation for the state in which the generating unit is located and where the RECs were issued.   technology_class varchar [note: 'The specific renewable energy technology classification of the generating unit, providing sub-category detail within the fuel_type. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: photovoltaic|concentrated_solar|onshore_wind|offshore_wind|run_of_river|pumped_storage|anaerobic_digestion|dedicated_biomass|landfill_gas_engine|geothermal_flash|geothermal_binary — promote to reference product]']
  total_cost decimal(18,2) [note: 'The total acquisition cost for this REC inventory position in U.S. dollars, calculated as quantity_mwh multiplied by cost_per_rec at time of acquisition. Stored as a raw financial fact for accounting and rate case purposes. Confidential as it reflects contract pricing.']
  transfer_date date [note: 'The date on which these RECs were transferred to another registry account or counterparty. Populated only when rec_status is \'transferred\'. Used for chain-of-custody tracking and audit.']
  updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'The timestamp when this REC inventory record was most recently modified in the Power and Utilities data platform. Follows ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Used for change tracking, data reconciliation, and audit purposes.']
  vintage_month varchar [note: 'The calendar month (1–12) within the vintage year in which the electricity underlying these RECs was generated. Provides sub-annual granularity for seasonal generation tracking and registry reconciliation.']
  vintage_year varchar [note: 'The calendar year in which the electricity underlying these RECs was generated.   Note: 'Master record tracking Renewable Energy Certificate (REC) inventory positions.   irp_submission_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to regulatory.irp_submission. Business justification: REC procurement transactions support renewable targets in integrated resource plans. Links REC acquisitions to IRP filings for demonstrating renewable portfolio strategy execution and compliance.']
  ppa_contract_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the Power Purchase Agreement (PPA) contract under which this REC transaction was executed. Links the REC transaction to the originating bilateral energy procurement or sale contract. Nullable for spot-market or registry-only transactions not tied to a PPA.']
  primary_rec_registry_account_id varchar [note: 'Power and Utilities\'s account identifier within the REC registry (e.g., WREGIS account number, M-RETS organization ID). Used to identify the Power and Utilities\'s registry account as the source or destination of the REC transfer. Required for registry reconciliation and audit.']
  rider_charge_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to regulatory.rider_charge. Business justification: REC procurement costs recovered through renewable energy riders. Links renewable energy credit transactions to specific tariff riders for cost recovery and rate calculation.']
  vendor_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to supply.vendor. Business justification: REC purchases often involve vendors as brokers or intermediaries. Links REC procurement to vendor master for payment processing, 1099 reporting, diversity spend tracking, and consolidated vendor perfo']
  wholesale_counterparty_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the counterparty entity (buyer, seller, or registry participant) involved in this REC transaction. Used for counterparty exposure reporting and RPS compliance audit trails submitted to state PUCs.']
  broker_name varchar [note: 'Name of the energy broker or intermediary that facilitated this REC transaction, if applicable. Null for direct bilateral transactions or registry self-transfers. Used for broker relationship management and fee reconciliation.']
  certificate_serial_end varchar [note: 'Ending serial number of the REC certificate block transferred or retired in this transaction, as assigned by the REC registry. Together with certificate_serial_start, defines the complete range of individual REC certificates covered by this transaction for audit and reconciliation purposes.']
  certificate_serial_start varchar [note: 'Starting serial number of the REC certificate block transferred or retired in this transaction, as assigned by the REC registry. REC registries assign unique serial numbers to each MWh certificate. The range from certificate_serial_start to certificate_serial_end defines the exact certificates involved.']
  compliance_program varchar [note: 'The regulatory or voluntary compliance program under which this REC transaction is being executed. \'RPS\' indicates state Renewable Portfolio Standard obligation; \'voluntary\' indicates green power or corporate sustainability purchase; \'federal_clean_energy\' indicates federal clean energy standard compliance; \'CHP\' indicates Combined Heat and Power (CHP) program; \'other\' for non-standard programs.']
  created_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp when this REC transaction record was first created in the Databricks Silver Layer data product, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Supports audit trail requirements for SOX financial controls and FERC market-based rate record retention.']
  currency_code varchar [note: 'Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts in this REC transaction record (e.g., USD for US Dollars). Power and Utilities operates primarily in USD; this field supports multi-currency PPA arrangements with international counterparties.']
  energy_source_type varchar [note: 'Classification of the renewable energy generation technology that produced the electricity underlying the RECs. Many state RPS programs have technology-specific carve-outs (e.g., solar carve-outs) that require RECs from specific generation types. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: solar|wind|hydro|geothermal|biomass|landfill_gas|other_renewable — promote to reference product if additional types are needed]']
  generation_facility_name varchar [note: 'Name of the renewable generation facility (power plant) that produced the electricity underlying the RECs. Used for RPS eligibility verification and registry certificate traceability. Corresponds to the facility name registered in the applicable REC registry.']
  generation_facility_state varchar [note: 'Two-letter US state code (USPS abbreviation) for the state in which the renewable generation facility is located. Many state RPS programs restrict eligible RECs to facilities located within the state or within a defined geographic region (e.g., in-state, regional grid).']
  gross_amount decimal(18,2) [note: 'Total gross monetary value of the REC transaction before any adjustments, fees, or discounts, calculated as quantity_mwh multiplied by price_per_rec. Expressed in US Dollars (USD). Used for revenue recognition, financial settlement, and FERC market-based rate reporting.']
  is_bundled boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the RECs in this transaction are bundled with the underlying electricity delivery (True) or are unbundled certificates traded separately from the physical energy (False). Bundled RECs are typically associated with PPA deliveries; unbundled RECs are traded independently in the REC market. Affects RPS eligibility in some states.']
  is_eligible_for_rps boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the RECs in this transaction have been verified as eligible for the applicable state Renewable Portfolio Standard (RPS) compliance program (True) or are ineligible/unverified (False). Eligibility is determined by generation technology, vintage year, facility location, and registry certification.']
  net_amount decimal(18,2) [note: 'Net monetary value of the REC transaction after deducting transaction fees from the gross amount, expressed in US Dollars (USD). Represents the actual cash settlement obligation between counterparties. Used for accounts payable/receivable posting in SAP S/4HANA or Oracle ERP.']
  notes varchar [note: 'Free-text field for additional business context, special conditions, or operational notes associated with this REC transaction. Used by energy traders and compliance analysts to document non-standard terms, dispute details, or regulatory correspondence references.']
  price_per_rec decimal(18,6) [note: 'Contracted or market price per REC in US Dollars (USD). Represents the unit price agreed upon between counterparties for purchase or sale transactions. Null for retirement-only or internal transfer transactions with no financial consideration. Sensitive commercial pricing data.']
  quantity_mwh decimal(18,6) [note: 'Number of Renewable Energy Certificates (RECs) involved in this transaction, expressed in Megawatt-Hours (MWh). One REC represents one MWh of electricity generated from a qualifying renewable resource. This is the principal quantitative fact for the transaction.']
  registry_confirmation_number varchar [note: 'Unique confirmation number issued by the REC registry (e.g., WREGIS, M-RETS, NAR) upon successful processing of the REC transfer or retirement. Serves as the authoritative audit trail reference for RPS compliance filings with state PUCs and FERC market-based rate reporting.']
  registry_name varchar [note: 'Name of the REC tracking registry through which this transaction was processed. Different RTOs and regions use different registries: WREGIS (Western US), M-RETS (Midwest), NAR (North American Renewables Registry), NEPOOL-GIS (New England), PJM-GATS (PJM region), ERCOT (Texas). Determines applicable operating rules and transfer confirmation procedures.']
  retirement_date date [note: 'Date on which RECs were permanently retired in the registry for compliance or voluntary purposes. Populated only for transactions of type \'retirement\'. Critical for RPS compliance period determination in state PUC filings.']
  rps_compliance_year varchar [note: 'The RPS compliance obligation year to which this REC transaction is applied. State PUC RPS programs require utilities to demonstrate compliance by retiring sufficient RECs for each annual compliance period. Populated for RPS-type transactions; null for voluntary transactions.']
  rto_iso_region varchar [note: 'The Regional Transmission Organization (RTO) or Independent System Operator (ISO) region in which the generation facility is located. Determines applicable market rules, registry requirements, and RPS eligibility criteria. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: CAISO|PJM|MISO|ERCOT|NYISO|ISO-NE|SPP|WECC|non-RTO — promote to reference product]']
  settlement_date date [note: 'Date on which financial settlement for the REC transaction was completed, including payment exchange between counterparties. May differ from transaction_date for forward or deferred settlement arrangements. Used for revenue recognition and GAAP financial reporting.']
  trade_confirmation_number varchar [note: 'Bilateral trade confirmation number exchanged between Power and Utilities and the counterparty at the time of deal execution, prior to registry transfer. Distinct from the registry_confirmation_number which is issued by the registry post-transfer. Used for pre-settlement reconciliation and dispute resolution.']
  transaction_date date [note: 'The principal real-world business event date on which the REC transaction was executed or agreed upon between counterparties. Used as the primary date for RPS compliance period assignment and FERC market-based rate reporting.']
  transaction_fee decimal(18,2) [note: 'Registry or broker fees assessed on this REC transaction, expressed in US Dollars (USD). Includes WREGIS, M-RETS, or NAR registry transfer fees and any applicable brokerage commissions. Deducted from gross amount to derive net settlement amount.']
  transaction_number varchar [note: 'Externally-known business identifier for this REC transaction, formatted as REC-{YYYY}-{sequence}. Used in counterparty communications, registry submissions, and regulatory filings with state PUCs. Corresponds to the transaction reference number in the REC registry system.']
  transaction_status varchar [note: 'Current lifecycle state of the REC transaction workflow. \'pending\' indicates awaiting registry confirmation; \'confirmed\' indicates registry transfer acknowledged; \'settled\' indicates financial settlement complete; \'retired\' indicates RECs permanently retired for compliance; \'cancelled\' indicates transaction voided; \'disputed\' indicates counterparty or registry dispute in progress.']
  transaction_type varchar [note: 'Classification of the REC transaction by its business purpose. \'transfer\' indicates a registry account-to-account transfer; \'retirement\' indicates permanent retirement of RECs for RPS or voluntary compliance; \'purchase\' indicates acquisition of RECs from a counterparty; \'sale\' indicates disposition of RECs to a counterparty.']
  updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp when this REC transaction record was last modified in the Databricks Silver Layer data product, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Used to detect record changes for downstream incremental processing and audit trail maintenance.']
  vintage_year varchar [note: 'The calendar year in which the electricity underlying the RECs was generated. REC vintage is a critical eligibility criterion for state RPS compliance programs — many states restrict eligible RECs to those generated within a specific vintage window.']

  Note: 'Transactional record for REC transfers, retirements, and purchases. Captures transaction type (transfer, retirement, purchase, sale), transaction date, quantity (MWh), counterparty, registry transfer confirmation number, price ($/REC), compliance program (RPS, voluntary), and associated PPA contract reference. Provides audit trail for RPS compliance filings with state PUCs.'
}

Table market.transmission_right {
  transmission_right_id varchar [pk, note: 'Unique surrogate identifier for each financial transmission right or transmission congestion contract record held by the utility. Primary key for the transmission_right data product.']
  capex_project_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to finance.capex_project. Business justification: FTR/CRR acquisitions may be linked to transmission capital projects for cost recovery analysis and rate base treatment. Enables tracking of transmission investment hedging strategy and regulatory cost']
  cost_center_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Transmission rights are managed by specific departments (transmission planning, wholesale trading) with budget accountability. Cost center enables tracking of FTR/CRR portfolio costs, hedging effectiv']
  cost_recovery_mechanism_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to regulatory.cost_recovery_mechanism. Business justification: Transmission hedging costs (FTR/CRR) recovered through specific riders. Links financial transmission rights to regulatory cost recovery mechanisms for congestion cost recovery.']
  portfolio_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the wholesale energy trading portfolio or book to which this transmission right is assigned. Enables aggregation of FTR/TCC positions by portfolio for risk management, P&L reporting, and IRP resource adequacy analysis.']
  primary_transmission_pricing_node_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the source pricing node that defines the injection point of the FTR/TCC path. The LMP at the source node is used in congestion settlement calculations. Corresponds to the generation or injection location in the RTO nodal model.']
  prudency_docket_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to regulatory.docket. Business justification: Transmission rights (FTR/CRR) acquisition costs are subject to regulatory prudency review. Links hedging instruments to regulatory proceedings for cost recovery approval and reasonableness determinati']
  rto_iso_id varchar [note: 'FK to market.rto_iso']
  source_pnode_pricing_node_id varchar [note: 'FK to market.pricing_node']
  transmission_pricing_node_id varchar [note: 'FK to market.pricing_node']
  wholesale_counterparty_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the RTO/ISO or secondary market counterparty from whom this transmission right was acquired or to whom it may be transferred. For primary auction acquisitions, the counterparty is typically the RTO/ISO itself.']
  acquisition_cost decimal(18,4) [note: 'The total cost paid by the utility to acquire this transmission right at auction, expressed in US dollars. A positive value indicates a premium paid; a negative value indicates revenue received (counter-flow FTRs may have negative acquisition costs). Used for portfolio cost basis tracking and FERC market-based rate reporting.']
  acquisition_method varchar [note: 'Indicates how the transmission right was obtained. PRIMARY_AUCTION indicates acquisition through the RTO/ISO annual or monthly FTR auction. SECONDARY_MARKET indicates purchase from another market participant. BILATERAL indicates a negotiated bilateral transfer. ALLOCATION indicates the right was allocated by the RTO/ISO (e.g., ARR conversion).']
  auction_clearing_price decimal(12,4) [note: 'The price per MW at which this transmission right cleared in the RTO/ISO FTR auction, expressed in dollars per megawatt ($/MW). Used to calculate total acquisition cost and benchmark against secondary market prices.']
  auction_round varchar [note: 'Identifies the specific RTO/ISO FTR auction round in which this transmission right was acquired (e.g., \'PJM-2024-ANN-R1\', \'MISO-2024-MON-JAN\'). Used to trace the right back to its originating auction event for audit and portfolio analysis.']
  auction_year varchar [note: 'The planning year (four-digit calendar year) associated with the FTR auction in which this right was acquired. Used for portfolio grouping, annual budget reporting, and IRP resource adequacy analysis.']
  congestion_zone_sink varchar [note: 'The congestion zone or load zone designation at the sink end of the transmission right path, as defined by the RTO/ISO. Used for zone-level aggregation and LMP basis spread exposure analysis.']
  congestion_zone_source varchar [note: 'The congestion zone or load zone designation at the source end of the transmission right path, as defined by the RTO/ISO. Used for zone-level aggregation and basis risk analysis when nodal-level detail is not required.']
  created_timestamp timestamp [note: 'The timestamp when this transmission right record was first created in the data platform, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Supports audit trail and data lineage requirements.']
  cumulative_settlement_amount decimal(18,4) [note: 'The total net congestion settlement revenue or cost received or paid to date for this transmission right since its effective date, expressed in US dollars. Positive values indicate net revenue received; negative values indicate net payments made. Supports portfolio performance tracking and FERC reporting.']
  effective_date date [note: 'The calendar date on which the transmission right becomes effective and eligible for congestion settlement. Marks the beginning of the right\'s term as defined in the RTO/ISO auction award.']
  expiration_date date [note: 'The calendar date on which the transmission right expires and is no longer eligible for congestion settlement. After this date the right has no further financial obligation or entitlement.']
  ferc_market_rate_auth_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this transmission right position is reportable under the utility\'s FERC market-based rate authority. True indicates the position must be included in FERC Electric Quarterly Report (EQR) filings and market power screens.']
  hedge_designation varchar [note: 'Accounting designation of the transmission right under GAAP ASC 815. CASH_FLOW_HEDGE designates the right as hedging variability in future cash flows from LMP congestion exposure. FAIR_VALUE_HEDGE designates it as hedging changes in fair value of a recognized asset or liability. ECONOMIC_HEDGE indicates the right provides economic offset but does not qualify for hedge accounting. SPECULATIVE indicates the right is held for trading or arbitrage purposes.']
  irp_resource_adequacy_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this transmission right is counted as part of the utility\'s IRP resource adequacy portfolio for regulatory planning purposes. True indicates the right is included in IRP transmission hedging strategy; False indicates it is held for other purposes (e.g., speculative or short-term trading).']
  last_settlement_date date [note: 'The most recent date on which a congestion settlement payment was processed for this transmission right by the RTO/ISO. Used to confirm settlement currency and identify rights with outstanding or delayed settlements.']
  lmp_basis_spread decimal(12,4) [note: 'The expected or realized LMP congestion price differential between the sink and source pricing nodes, expressed in dollars per megawatt-hour ($/MWh). Represents the basis spread this right is intended to hedge. Used in portfolio risk analytics and IRP congestion cost modeling.']
  mark_to_market_value decimal(18,4) [note: 'The current fair market value of the transmission right expressed in US dollars, based on the most recent secondary market prices or RTO/ISO valuation. Used for financial reporting under GAAP ASC 815 fair value accounting and portfolio risk management.']
  mtm_valuation_date date [note: 'The date as of which the mark-to-market value was last calculated or updated. Required for financial reporting to confirm the currency of the fair value estimate.']
  mw_quantity decimal(12,4) [note: 'The capacity quantity of the transmission right expressed in megawatts (MW). Represents the notional MW amount for which the holder receives or pays the congestion component of LMP between source and sink nodes. Determines the settlement payment magnitude.']
  notes varchar [note: 'Free-text field for capturing supplementary information about the transmission right, such as special auction conditions, regulatory filing references, portfolio strategy rationale, or operational constraints not captured in structured fields.']
  right_code varchar [note: 'Externally-known alphanumeric identifier assigned by the RTO/ISO auction system or internal portfolio management system to uniquely identify this FTR or TCC instrument. Used for reconciliation with RTO settlement statements.']
  right_direction varchar [note: 'Indicates the directional flow of the transmission right along the source-to-sink path. FORWARD denotes flow from source pricing node to sink pricing node. COUNTER denotes the reverse direction, used for counter-flow FTRs that hedge congestion in the opposite direction.']
  right_type varchar [note: 'Classification of the transmission right instrument. FTR_OBLIGATION entitles the holder to receive or pay the congestion component of LMP between source and sink. FTR_OPTION provides the right but not the obligation to collect congestion revenue. TCC (Transmission Congestion Contract) is the NYISO equivalent. ARR (Auction Revenue Right) is a pre-cursor entitlement used in some RTO markets to participate in FTR auctions.']
  term_type varchar [note: 'Categorizes the duration class of the transmission right as defined by the RTO/ISO auction structure. MONTHLY rights are acquired in monthly auctions. SEASONAL rights span a defined seasonal period. ANNUAL rights cover a full planning year. LONG_TERM rights extend beyond one year and are subject to long-term FTR auction rules under FERC Order 681.']
  transfer_eligible boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this transmission right is eligible for transfer or sale in the secondary market under applicable RTO/ISO tariff rules. True indicates the right may be transferred; False indicates it is non-transferable (e.g., certain ARR allocations).']
  transmission_right_status varchar [note: 'Current lifecycle status of the transmission right. ACTIVE indicates the right is within its effective term and eligible for settlement. EXPIRED indicates the term has ended. CANCELLED indicates the right was terminated prior to expiration. PENDING indicates the right has been awarded but not yet effective. SURRENDERED indicates the holder voluntarily returned the right to the RTO.']
  updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'The timestamp when this transmission right record was most recently modified in the data platform, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Used to detect stale records and support incremental data processing in the Databricks Silver layer.']

  Note: 'Master record for financial transmission rights (FTRs) and transmission congestion contracts (TCCs) held by the utility for congestion hedging. Captures right type (FTR obligation, FTR option, TCC, ARR/auction revenue right), source pricing node, sink pricing node, MW quantity, path direction, auction round, term (monthly, seasonal, annual, long-term), acquisition cost ($), current mark-to-market value ($), and expiration date. Each FTR references source and sink pricing nodes for path definition. Used to hedge transmission congestion costs between generation and load delivery points and manage LMP basis spread exposure in the wholesale market portfolio.'
}

Table market.pricing_node {
  pricing_node_id varchar [pk, note: 'Unique surrogate identifier for the pricing node record in the Silver Layer lakehouse. Primary key for this master resource entity.']
  apnode_pricing_node_id varchar [note: 'The RTO/ISO-assigned identifier of the aggregated pricing node (APNode) that groups this generator bus node for scheduling and settlement purposes. APNodes are used in CAISO and similar markets to aggregate multiple generator buses under a single scheduling point. Null for non-generator-bus node types.']
  hub_node_id varchar [note: 'The RTO/ISO-assigned identifier of the virtual trading hub node associated with this pricing node. Hub nodes (e.g., PJM Western Hub, CAISO NP15 Hub) serve as reference points for bilateral contract pricing and FTR settlement. Null for non-hub node types.']
  location_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to asset.asset_location. Business justification: Pricing nodes at generation interconnection points or major substations must link to physical asset locations for LMP analysis, congestion cost allocation, transmission planning studies, and spatial c']
  ancillary_services_eligible boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this pricing node is eligible to provide ancillary services (regulation up/down, spinning reserve, non-spinning reserve, voltage support) in the RTO/ISO market. Used for ancillary services bid mapping and capacity obligation tracking.']
  bus_number varchar [note: 'The electrical bus number in the transmission network model (power flow model) corresponding to this pricing node. Used in SCADA/EMS systems (ABB or GE Energy Management System) for state estimation, contingency analysis, and LMP decomposition into energy, congestion, and loss components.']
  capacity_market_zone varchar [note: 'The capacity market zone or locational deliverability area (LDA) designation assigned by the RTO/ISO for capacity market obligations and auctions (e.g., PJM MAAC, EMAAC; NYISO Zone J; ISO-NE NEMA). Used for resource adequacy analysis in the IRP and capacity auction bid preparation.']
  country_code varchar [note: 'ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 three-letter country code for the country in which this pricing node is located (e.g., USA, CAN, MEX). Relevant for cross-border interface nodes and international transmission interconnections.']
  dam_eligible boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this pricing node is eligible for Day-Ahead Market (DAM) bid submission and settlement. True for nodes that can participate in the DAM; False for nodes restricted to real-time or ancillary services markets only.']
  effective_date date [note: 'The date on which this pricing node became effective and eligible for LMP settlement and market participation. Defines the start of the node\'s active period for historical LMP price lookups and FTR path eligibility. Aligns with RTO/ISO market effective date conventions.']
  ems_node_code varchar [note: 'The node identifier in the ABB or GE Energy Management System (EMS) network model corresponding to this pricing node. Used for state estimation, contingency analysis, and real-time LMP decomposition into energy, congestion, and loss components.']
  expiration_date date [note: 'The date on which this pricing node ceased to be effective. Null for currently active nodes. Used to support slowly changing dimension (SCD) logic in the Silver Layer and to bound historical LMP settlement lookups to the node\'s valid period.']
  ftr_eligible boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this pricing node is eligible as a source or sink point for Financial Transmission Rights (FTR) path definitions. FTR eligibility is required for congestion hedging in the utility\'s wholesale market portfolio.']

  installed_capacity_mw decimal(12,3) [note: 'The nameplate or installed generation capacity in megawatts (MW) associated with this pricing node when node type is generator_bus.   latitude decimal(9,6) [note: 'WGS84 decimal degree latitude of the pricing node\'s physical location. Used for geographic visualization in ESRI ArcGIS, spatial analysis of congestion patterns, and mapping of LMP heat maps for IRP and transmission planning studies.']
  lmp_currency_code varchar [note: 'ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the LMP reference price (e.g., USD). Supports multi-currency environments for cross-border nodes and international market participation.']
  lmp_reference_price decimal(12,4) [note: 'The most recently published or baseline reference LMP in dollars per megawatt-hour ($/MWh) for this pricing node. Serves as a reference value for contract pricing, FTR valuation, and IRP resource adequacy analysis. Not a real-time or interval value — use the lmp_interval_data product for time-series LMP data.']
  load_zone_code varchar [note: 'The RTO/ISO-assigned load zone identifier to which this pricing node belongs or aggregates into. Load zones are used for zonal LMP settlement, capacity market obligations, and demand response program administration. Null for hub and interface node types.']

  market_region varchar [note: 'The sub-regional market area or control zone within the RTO/ISO to which this pricing node belongs (e.g., CAISO NP15, SP15, ZP26; PJM PSEG zone; MISO Zone 7). Used for zonal LMP aggregation, load forecasting, and congestion analysis.']
  nerc_balancing_authority varchar [note: 'The NERC-registered Balancing Authority (BA) area code responsible for maintaining load-generation balance at this pricing node\'s location (e.g., CISO, PJM, MISO). This is the business-facing key used in market settlement systems, LMP price lookups, and bid submissions. Maps to the pnode_id field in RTO/ISO market data feeds.']
  pnode_name varchar [note: 'Human-readable name of the pricing node as designated by the RTO/ISO. Used in market reports, settlement statements, and bid location mapping. Examples include generator bus names, load zone names, and hub designations.']
  pnode_owner_type varchar [note: 'Classifies the ownership relationship of the utility to this pricing node.   pnode_type varchar [note: 'Classification of the pricing node by its functional role in the wholesale market. Generator bus nodes represent individual generation injection points; load zone nodes represent aggregated load areas; hub nodes are virtual trading points; interface nodes represent inter-regional tie points; aggregated pnodes (APnodes) aggregate multiple generator buses for scheduling purposes.']
  rec_eligible boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the generation resource at this pricing node is eligible to generate Renewable Energy Certificates (RECs) for RPS compliance.   record_created_timestamp timestamp [note: 'The timestamp when this pricing node record was first created in the Silver Layer lakehouse. Supports audit trail, data lineage, and SCD Type 2 history management. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.']
  record_updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'The timestamp when this pricing node record was most recently updated in the Silver Layer lakehouse. Used for incremental ETL processing, change detection, and audit trail maintenance. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.']
  rtm_eligible boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this pricing node is eligible for Real-Time Market (RTM) dispatch and settlement. True for nodes participating in the RTM; False for nodes limited to DAM or forward market products only.']
  rto_iso_code varchar [note: 'Identifies the RTO or ISO that administers this pricing node and publishes its LMP prices. Determines which market rules, settlement procedures, and tariff provisions apply. Essential for multi-RTO utilities to partition market data by jurisdiction. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: CAISO|PJM|MISO|ERCOT|NYISO|ISO-NE|SPP|WECC — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]']
  scada_point_code varchar [note: 'The OSIsoft PI or GE Proficy historian tag identifier for the real-time telemetry point associated with this pricing node. Enables linkage between the market pricing node and real-time SCADA measurements for dispatch verification, settlement validation, and operational analytics.']
  source_system_code varchar [note: 'Identifies the originating system from which this pricing node record was sourced. Supports data lineage tracking in the Silver Layer lakehouse and ETL reconciliation. RTO_* codes indicate direct feeds from RTO/ISO market data APIs; INTERNAL_EMS indicates the utility\'s own EMS network model. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: RTO_CAISO|RTO_PJM|RTO_MISO|RTO_ERCOT|RTO_NYISO|RTO_ISONE|RTO_SPP|INTERNAL_EMS — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]']
  state_code varchar [note: 'Two-letter US state abbreviation (USPS standard) indicating the state jurisdiction in which this pricing node is physically located. Used for state PUC regulatory reporting, RPS compliance tracking, and jurisdictional cost allocation.']
  substation_code varchar [note: 'The utility\'s internal substation or bus identifier to which this pricing node is physically associated. Links the market pricing node to the physical grid asset in the GIS and EAM systems (ESRI ArcGIS, Oracle WAM/IBM Maximo). Used for FTR path definitions and outage impact analysis.']
  transmission_owner_code varchar [note: 'The FERC-registered identifier or internal code of the transmission owner responsible for the physical transmission facilities at this pricing node. Used for OATT cost allocation, transmission service requests, and FERC Form 1 regulatory reporting.']
  voltage_kv decimal(10,3) [note: 'The nominal operating voltage level in kilovolts (kV) at this pricing node\'s associated bus. Distinguishes transmission-level nodes (e.g., 115 kV, 230 kV, 500 kV) from distribution-level injection points. Used in network model validation and FTR eligibility determination.']

  Note: 'Reference master for all RTO/ISO pricing nodes (pnodes), aggregated pricing nodes (APnodes), load zones, and hub nodes relevant to the utility\'s market participation. Captures pnode ID, pnode name, pnode type (generator bus, load zone, hub, interface), RTO/ISO affiliation, associated substation or bus, effective date range, and geographic coordinates. Foundational reference for LMP price lookups, FTR path definitions, and bid location mapping.'
}

  nerc_function_codes varchar [note: 'Comma-separated list of NERC functional entity registration codes applicable to this participant (e.g., BA=Balancing Authority, TO=Transmission Owner, GO=Generator Owner, LSE=Load-Serving Entity, DP=Distribution Provider).   nerc_registered_entity_code varchar [note: 'The unique identifier assigned by the North American Electric Reliability Corporation (NERC) to the utility as a registered reliability entity (e.g., Transmission Operator, Balancing Authority, Generator Operator). Links market participation to NERC reliability compliance obligations.']
  oatt_filing_date date [note: 'The date on which the utility filed its Open Access Transmission Tariff (OATT) with FERC, establishing the terms and conditions for transmission service. Relevant for transmission owner registrations.']
  participant_type varchar [note: 'Classification of the utility\'s role in the wholesale energy market as registered with the RTO/ISO. Determines which market products and services the participant is authorized to transact. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: load_serving_entity|generator_owner|transmission_owner|marketer|power_marketer|distribution_utility|combined_utility — promote to reference product]']
  primary_contact_email varchar [note: 'Email address of the primary contact person responsible for market operations and RTO/ISO communications under this registration. Used for regulatory correspondence, market notices, and settlement dispute communications.']

  primary_contact_phone varchar [note: 'Phone number of the primary contact person responsible for market operations and RTO/ISO communications under this registration.']
  rec_tracking_program varchar [note: 'The REC tracking registry or program in which the utility is enrolled under this market registration for tracking and retiring Renewable Energy Certificates (RECs) to demonstrate RPS compliance (e.g., GATS, M-RETS, WREGIS, NEPOOL GIS). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: GATS|MRETS|WREGIS|NEPOOL-GIS|PJM-GATS|ERCOT-REC|NAR — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]']

  registration_status varchar [note: 'Current lifecycle status of the market participant registration with the RTO/ISO. Active indicates full market participation rights; suspended indicates temporary restriction; terminated indicates the registration has been withdrawn or revoked.']
  regulatory_contact_email varchar [note: 'Email address of the regulatory affairs contact responsible for FERC filings and compliance activities associated with this market registration.']
  regulatory_contact_name varchar [note: 'Full name of the regulatory affairs contact responsible for FERC filings, rate case management, and PUC compliance activities associated with this market registration. May differ from the primary market operations contact.']
  rps_compliance_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this market participant registration is associated with Renewable Portfolio Standard (RPS) compliance activities, including Renewable Energy Certificate (REC) tracking and procurement.']

[ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: PJM|MISO|CAISO|ERCOT|NYISO|ISO-NE|SPP — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]']
  rto_iso_participant_code varchar [note: 'The unique participant identifier assigned by the specific RTO/ISO to the utility as a registered market participant. Essential for FERC compliance and market operations.']
  state_jurisdiction varchar [note: 'The U.S. state(s) in which the utility holds a Certificate of Public Convenience and Necessity (CPCN) and is subject to state Public Utility Commission (PUC) jurisdiction.   termination_date date [note: 'The date on which the market participant registration was terminated or is scheduled to terminate. Null for active, open-ended registrations. Used for historical tracking and FERC compliance reporting.']
  unsecured_credit_limit_usd decimal(18,2) [note: 'The maximum unsecured credit limit in US dollars extended by the RTO/ISO to the utility under this registration, based on credit rating and financial standing. Amounts above this limit require collateral posting.']
  updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'The timestamp when this participant registration record was most recently updated in the data platform. Supports change tracking, audit trail, and incremental data processing in the Databricks Silver Layer.']
  virtual_bidding_authorized boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the utility is authorized to submit virtual bids (increment offers / decrement bids) in the Day-Ahead Market under this registration. Virtual bidding is used for financial arbitrage between DAM and RTM prices.']

  Note: 'Reference master for the utility\'s own registered market participant identities across multiple RTOs/ISOs. Captures participant ID assigned by each RTO/ISO, market registration type (load-serving entity, generator owner, transmission owner, marketer), FERC market-based rate docket number, registration effective date, and active market products authorized (energy, capacity, ancillary services, FTR). Table market.settlement_line_item {
  settlement_line_item_id varchar [pk, note: 'Unique identifier for the settlement line item record. Primary key for the settlement line item entity.']
  capacity_obligation_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key reference to the capacity market obligation associated with this settlement line item. Links capacity charges and credits to specific auction commitments and delivery obligations.']
  cost_center_id varchar [note: 'FK to finance.cost_center']
  generating_unit_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key reference to the generation or demand response resource associated with this settlement line item. Identifies the physical or virtual asset that generated the charge or credit.']
  gl_account_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to finance.gl_account. Business justification: Each settlement line item must post to a specific GL account for financial statement preparation and FERC reporting. Core accounting integration for revenue recognition, expense matching, and regulato']
  netting_settlement_line_item_id varchar [note: 'Self-referencing FK on settlement_line_item (netting_settlement_line_item_id)']
  original_line_item_settlement_line_item_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key reference to the original settlement line item that this record adjusts or replaces. Creates an audit trail for resettlements and dispute adjustments.']
  participant_registration_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key reference to the wholesale market participant responsible for this settlement line item. Identifies the counterparty for the transaction.']
  ppa_contract_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key reference to the PPA contract associated with this settlement line item. Links wholesale market settlements to bilateral contract positions for hedge accounting and portfolio management.']
  pricing_node_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key reference to the pricing node (pnode) where the energy or service was delivered or received. Links settlement charges to specific locations in the transmission grid for LMP-based settlement.']
  rto_iso_id varchar [note: 'FK to market.rto_iso']
  settlement_statement_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key reference to the parent settlement statement. Each line item belongs to exactly one settlement statement issued by the RTO/ISO.']
  adjustment_reason_code varchar [note: 'Code indicating the reason for any adjustment to the original settlement line item. Documents meter data corrections, tariff interpretation changes, or dispute resolutions that trigger resettlement.']
  ancillary_service_type varchar [note: 'Type of ancillary service for which this line item applies. Identifies the specific grid reliability service procured or provided (regulation, reserves, voltage support, black start capability).']
  billing_determinant_quantity decimal(18,3) [note: 'Quantity of the billing determinant (MW, MWh, MW-day, or other unit) used to calculate the line item charge. Represents the volume of energy, capacity, or service delivered or consumed.']
  billing_determinant_unit varchar [note: 'Unit of measure for the billing determinant quantity. Specifies whether the charge is based on energy (MWh), capacity (MW), demand (MW-day), or reactive power (MVAR).']
  charge_code varchar [note: 'Detailed RTO/ISO-specific charge code identifying the exact settlement product or service. Maps to the ISO tariff schedule and enables granular GL posting and dispute resolution.']
  charge_description varchar [note: 'Human-readable description of the charge or credit line item. Provides business context for the settlement transaction and supports audit trail documentation.']
  charge_type varchar [note: 'High-level category of the settlement charge or credit. Classifies the line item into major wholesale market product categories for financial reporting and analysis. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: energy|capacity|ancillary_service|transmission|congestion|loss|uplift|make_whole_payment|revenue_sufficiency_guarantee|oatt_charge|administrative_fee|penalty|credit_adjustment — promote to reference product]']
  created_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp when this settlement line item record was first created in the lakehouse. Supports data lineage and audit trail requirements.']
  currency_code varchar [note: 'Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the line amount. Typically USD for U.S. RTOs/ISOs, CAD for Canadian markets, or MXN for Mexican markets.']
  dispute_reference_number varchar [note: 'Reference number for any dispute filed against this settlement line item. Links to the RTO/ISO dispute resolution process and tracks contested charges through adjudication.']
  ferc_account_code varchar [note: 'FERC Uniform System of Accounts code for regulatory reporting. Classifies the line item into standardized FERC accounts for Schedule 2 (Purchased Power) and other FERC Form 1 schedules.']
  line_amount decimal(18,2) [note: 'Total dollar amount for this settlement line item. Calculated as billing determinant quantity multiplied by rate per unit, plus any adjustments. Positive values represent charges; negative values represent credits.']
  line_item_number varchar [note: 'Sequential line number within the parent settlement statement. Used for ordering and referencing specific charges or credits within the statement.']
  line_item_status varchar [note: 'Current lifecycle status of the settlement line item. Tracks whether the charge is preliminary, final, under dispute, or has been adjusted through resettlement.']
  lmp_congestion_component decimal(18,6) [note: 'Congestion component of the Locational Marginal Price. Reflects the cost of transmission constraints and is used to allocate congestion charges and Financial Transmission Rights (FTR) revenues.']
  lmp_energy_component decimal(18,6) [note: 'Energy component of the Locational Marginal Price used in settlement calculation. Represents the marginal cost of serving the next increment of load at the pricing node, excluding congestion and losses.']
  lmp_loss_component decimal(18,6) [note: 'Loss component of the Locational Marginal Price. Represents the marginal cost of electrical losses in the transmission system between the pricing node and the system reference bus.']
  market_type varchar [note: 'Wholesale market in which the transaction occurred. Distinguishes between Day-Ahead Market (DAM), Real-Time Market (RTM), capacity auctions, and ancillary services markets.']
  operating_date date [note: 'Operating day for which the settlement charge or credit applies. Used for daily aggregation and reporting of wholesale market costs and revenues.']
  operating_hour varchar [note: 'Operating hour (0-23) within the operating date. Supports hourly settlement analysis and peak/off-peak cost allocation.']
  rate_per_unit decimal(18,6) [note: 'Unit rate applied to the billing determinant to calculate the line item amount. Expressed in currency per unit (e.g., USD per MWh, USD per MW-day). May represent LMP, capacity clearing price, or ancillary service rate.']
  rec_eligible_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the energy associated with this settlement line item is eligible for Renewable Energy Certificate (REC) generation. Supports RPS compliance tracking and REC inventory management.']
  settlement_interval_end_timestamp timestamp [note: 'End timestamp of the settlement interval to which this line item applies. Defines the conclusion of the operating period for the settled transaction.']
  settlement_interval_start_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Start timestamp of the settlement interval to which this line item applies. Defines the beginning of the operating period for energy, capacity, or ancillary service delivery.']
  settlement_period varchar [note: 'Settlement period identifier assigned by the RTO/ISO. Typically formatted as YYYYMM or a billing cycle code. Used to group line items into monthly or periodic settlement runs.']
  source_system_record_code varchar [note: 'Unique identifier from the RTO/ISO settlement system. Enables reconciliation between the utility internal settlement database and the ISO published settlement data.']
  statement_run_type varchar [note: 'Type of settlement run that produced this line item. Distinguishes between initial settlements, final settlements, resettlements due to meter data corrections, and dispute adjustments.']
  updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp when this settlement line item record was last modified. Tracks changes through resettlement cycles and dispute resolution processes.']

  Note: 'Transactional detail record for individual charge and credit line items within an RTO/ISO wholesale market settlement statement. Captures charge type (energy, capacity, ancillary service, uplift, OATT, revenue sufficiency guarantee, make-whole payment), charge code, billing determinant (MW, MWh), rate ($/MWh or $/MW-day), line amount ($), pricing node, settlement interval, market product, and GL account mapping. Each line item references its parent settlement statement. Essential for shadow settlement verification, dispute resolution, FERC Form 1 Schedule 2 reporting, and granular GL posting of wholesale market costs and revenues.'
}

  renewable_energy_zone_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this zone is designated as a Renewable Energy Zone with special interconnection or transmission rules for renewable generation (True/False).']

  status varchar [note: 'Current operational status of the market zone: active (currently in use), inactive (temporarily suspended), pending (awaiting activation), or retired (permanently decommissioned).']
  time_zone varchar [note: 'Standard time zone abbreviation for this market zone (e.g., EST, CST, PST, MST) used for scheduling and settlement timestamps.']
  transmission_constraint_area varchar [note: 'Identifier for the transmission constraint area or congestion zone that this market zone belongs to, used for managing grid congestion and calculating congestion charges.']

  zone_type varchar [note: 'Classification of the market zone indicating its primary function: load zone (demand aggregation), generation zone (supply aggregation), hub (pricing node), interface (interconnection point), or aggregate (composite zone).']

  Note: 'Master reference table for market_zone. Referenced by zone_id.'

May specify minimum coverage amounts and require utility to be named as additional insured. Critical for risk transfer and regulatory compliance.']
  last_amendment_date date [note: 'Date of the most recent contract amendment or modification. Amendments may adjust pricing, quantities, scope, or terms. Nullable if no amendments have been executed. Used for contract change tracking and version control.']
  last_updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp of the most recent modification to this procurement contract record. Captures updates to status, pricing, quantities, or any other contract attribute. Used for change tracking and data freshness assessment.']
  maximum_quantity_commitment decimal(18,3) [note: 'Contractually allowed maximum purchase quantity over the contract period. Protects vendor from unlimited demand and utility from supply shortages. Common in fuel supply contracts and equipment framework agreements. Nullable for open-ended service agreements.']
  minimum_quantity_commitment decimal(18,3) [note: 'Contractually obligated minimum purchase quantity over the contract period. Common in fuel supply contracts (e.g., minimum annual MCF (Thousand Cubic Feet) of natural gas or tons of coal) and equipment blanket orders. Failure to meet minimum may trigger penalties or price adjustments. Nullable for value contracts or service agreements without quantity commitments.']
  notes varchar [note: 'Free-text field for additional contract information, special conditions, negotiation history, or operational notes. May capture unique contract provisions, vendor relationship context, or procurement strategy rationale not captured in structured fields.']
  payment_terms varchar [note: 'Contractual payment schedule and conditions. Examples include Net 30, Net 60, 2/10 Net 30 (2% discount if paid within 10 days), progress payments for construction contracts, or milestone-based payments for project services. Impacts cash flow management and vendor relationship.']
  performance_guarantee varchar [note: 'Contractual performance commitments and associated remedies. May include delivery time guarantees, quality specifications, service level agreements (SLAs), equipment performance warranties, or fuel quality specifications (BTU content, sulfur content). Defines vendor accountability and utility recourse for non-performance.']
  price_escalation_clause varchar [note: 'Description of contractual price adjustment mechanism over time. May reference inflation indices (CPI, PPI), commodity indices (Henry Hub for natural gas, coal price indices), labor rate adjustments, or fixed annual percentage increases. Critical for multi-year contract cost forecasting and budget planning.']
  price_unit_of_measure varchar [note: 'Unit of measure for pricing. Examples include per MCF for natural gas, per ton for coal, per MWh for power, per each for equipment, per hour for labor services. Must align with quantity unit of measure for accurate cost calculation.']
  purchasing_group varchar [note: 'Buyer group or category team responsible for this contract. Examples include generation fuel team, substation equipment team, fleet services team, or IT procurement team. Used for workload distribution and specialized procurement expertise.']
  purchasing_organization varchar [note: 'Organizational unit within the utility responsible for procurement activities under this contract. May represent corporate procurement, generation fuel procurement, T&D (Transmission and Distribution) materials, or regional procurement centers. Aligns with SAP purchasing organization structure.']
  quantity_unit_of_measure varchar [note: 'Unit of measure for quantity commitments and releases. Examples include MCF (Thousand Cubic Feet) or BCF (Billion Cubic Feet) for natural gas, tons for coal, MWh (Megawatt-Hour) for purchased power, each for equipment units, or hours for service contracts. Must align with vendor invoicing and inventory management units.']
  regulatory_compliance_requirements varchar [note: 'Contractual obligations for vendor compliance with utility industry regulations. May include NERC (North American Electric Reliability Corporation) CIP (Critical Infrastructure Protection) requirements for cyber security, OSHA (Occupational Safety and Health Administration) safety standards, EPA (Environmental Protection Agency) environmental regulations, or state PUC (Public Utility Commission) procurement rules. Ensures vendor activities do not create regulatory risk for utility.']
  renewal_terms varchar [note: 'Contractual provisions for contract extension or renewal. May specify automatic renewal unless notice given, option periods with defined pricing, or requirement for renegotiation. Includes notice period requirements (e.g., 90 days prior to expiration) and conditions for renewal pricing adjustments.']
  sap_outline_agreement_number varchar [note: 'SAP S/4HANA system document number for the outline agreement (contract or scheduling agreement) record. Enables integration between procurement contract master data and SAP MM (Materials Management) purchase order release, goods receipt, and invoice verification processes. Critical for ERP (Enterprise Resource Planning) system traceability.']
  termination_clause varchar [note: 'Contractual provisions allowing early termination by either party. May include termination for convenience (with notice period and penalties), termination for cause (vendor non-performance, safety violations), force majeure provisions, or change-in-law provisions. Critical for risk management and contract flexibility.']
  total_contract_value decimal(18,2) [note: 'Maximum financial commitment under this contract in USD (United States Dollars). For value contracts, represents the spending limit; for quantity contracts, represents estimated total value based on committed quantities and unit prices. Used for budget planning, spend tracking, and contract authority approval thresholds.']

  Note: 'Master record for long-term supply agreements, blanket purchase agreements, fuel supply contracts, and framework contracts with vendors. Captures contract number, contract type (quantity contract, value contract, fuel PPA, service agreement), validity period, total contract value, minimum/maximum quantity commitments, price escalation clauses, fuel index linkage (e.g., Henry Hub for gas), renewal terms, and SAP outline agreement document number. Distinct from regulatory contracts (owned by regulatory domain) and customer service agreements (owned by customer domain).'
}

Table supply.inventory_stock {
  inventory_stock_id varchar [pk, note: 'Unique identifier for the inventory stock position record. Primary key for the inventory_stock product.']
  material_master_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the material master record. Links to the material_master product to identify the specific material (spare part, equipment, fuel, consumable) held in inventory.']
  warehouse_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the warehouse or storage location where the material is physically held. Links to the warehouse product to identify the facility (central warehouse, field storeroom, generation plant stores).']
  abc_classification varchar [note: 'ABC inventory classification based on consumption value or criticality. A = high-value/high-turnover items requiring tight control; B = moderate-value items; C = low-value/low-turnover items; X = unclassified or new materials. Used for cycle count frequency and inventory management strategy.']
  blocked_stock_quantity decimal(18,3) [note: 'Quantity of material blocked from use due to quality issues, damage, obsolescence, or regulatory hold. Material in this status cannot be issued and may require disposition (scrap, return to vendor, rework).']
  consignment_stock_quantity decimal(18,3) [note: 'Quantity of material held on consignment from a vendor. Material is physically at the utility location but remains vendor-owned until consumed. Common for high-value spare parts and generation fuel.']
  created_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp when this inventory stock position record was first created in the system. Typically corresponds to the first goods receipt at this storage location for this material.']
  expiration_date date [note: 'Expiration or shelf-life end date for perishable or time-sensitive materials (chemicals, lubricants, safety equipment, medical supplies). Material should not be issued after this date. Null for non-perishable materials.']
  in_transit_stock_quantity decimal(18,3) [note: 'Quantity of material currently in transit between storage locations or from vendor to warehouse. Material in this status is owned but not yet physically available at the destination location. Tracked via stock transfer orders.']
  issued_quantity decimal(18,3) [note: 'Cumulative quantity of material issued from this stock position during the current period. Backed by goods_issue transactions. Used for consumption tracking and inventory turnover analysis.']
  last_goods_issue_date date [note: 'Date of the most recent goods issue transaction that decreased stock at this location. Used for inventory turnover analysis and obsolescence detection.']
  last_goods_receipt_date date [note: 'Date of the most recent goods receipt transaction that increased stock at this location. Used for inventory aging analysis and slow-moving stock identification.']
  last_physical_inventory_count_date date [note: 'Date of the most recent physical inventory count (cycle count or annual inventory) performed for this material at this location. Used for inventory accuracy tracking and audit compliance. Regulatory requirements may mandate minimum count frequency.']
  last_updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp of the most recent update to this inventory stock position record. Updated by goods receipt, goods issue, stock transfer, physical inventory, or reservation transactions. Used for data freshness validation and change tracking.']
  lot_number varchar [note: 'Manufacturer or vendor lot/batch number for lot-managed materials. Used for traceability, quality control, and recall management. Critical for generation fuel, chemicals, and safety equipment. May be null for non-lot-managed materials.']
  maximum_stock_level decimal(18,3) [note: 'Maximum stock quantity threshold for this material at this location. Used to prevent overstocking and optimize working capital. Replenishment orders target this level. Breach indicates potential excess inventory.']
  moving_average_cost_per_unit decimal(18,4) [note: 'Moving average cost per unit of measure for this material. Recalculated with each goods receipt based on actual purchase prices. Used for inventory valuation when moving average costing method is applied. Confidential business financial data.']
  mrp_controller varchar [note: 'Three-character code identifying the MRP controller or inventory planner responsible for managing replenishment and stock levels for this material. Used for workload distribution and accountability.']
  physical_inventory_variance_quantity decimal(18,3) [note: 'Quantity difference between system book stock and physical count from the last inventory count. Positive values indicate physical surplus; negative values indicate shortage. Used for inventory accuracy metrics and shrinkage analysis.']
  plant_code varchar [note: 'Four-character code identifying the utility plant or operational facility to which this inventory stock position belongs (generation plant, service center, operations hub).']
  procurement_type varchar [note: 'Indicates how this material is procured. External = purchased from vendors; internal = manufactured or transferred from other plants; both = can be procured either way. Drives replenishment logic.']
  quality_inspection_stock_quantity decimal(18,3) [note: 'Quantity of material currently held in quality inspection status. Material in this status cannot be issued until quality control approval is received. Common for critical spare parts and generation fuel deliveries.']
  reorder_point decimal(18,3) [note: 'Minimum stock level threshold that triggers automatic replenishment. When unrestricted stock falls below this level, a purchase requisition or stock transfer request is generated. Set based on lead time and consumption rate.']
  reorder_point_breach_flag boolean [note: 'Boolean indicator that the current unrestricted stock quantity has fallen below the reorder point threshold. True indicates replenishment action is required. Used for inventory exception reporting and automated procurement triggers.']
  reserved_quantity decimal(18,3) [note: 'Quantity of material reserved for specific work orders, CAPEX projects, or planned maintenance activities. Reserved stock is committed but not yet issued. Backed by material_reservation transactions.']
  safety_stock decimal(18,3) [note: 'Minimum buffer stock level maintained to protect against demand variability and supply disruptions. Safety stock is not intended for normal consumption and breach indicates critical shortage risk. Critical for storm restoration materials and generation spare parts.']
  safety_stock_breach_flag boolean [note: 'Boolean indicator that the current unrestricted stock quantity has fallen below the safety stock threshold. True indicates critical shortage condition requiring immediate attention. Triggers escalated replenishment and potential emergency procurement.']
  special_stock_indicator varchar [note: 'Indicator for special stock types that require separate tracking. Project = stock allocated to specific CAPEX projects; sales_order = stock for specific customer orders; consignment = vendor-owned stock; returnable_packaging = containers/pallets; pipeline = in-transit between locations; subcontractor = stock at contractor site; none = standard stock. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: project|sales_order|consignment|returnable_packaging|pipeline|subcontractor|none — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]']
  standard_cost_per_unit decimal(18,4) [note: 'Standard cost per unit of measure for this material. Used for inventory valuation when standard costing method is applied. Represents the planned or budgeted cost per unit. Confidential business financial data.']
  stock_determination_group varchar [note: 'Four-character code used for automatic stock determination logic in goods issue processes. Groups materials with similar characteristics for automated picking and allocation rules.']
  stock_status varchar [note: 'Current operational status of the stock position. Available = normal stock levels; low_stock = below reorder point; out_of_stock = zero unrestricted quantity; excess = above maximum level; obsolete = material no longer used; inactive = location no longer stocking this material.']
  stock_type varchar [note: 'High-level categorization of stock ownership and purpose. Own = utility-owned unrestricted stock; consignment = vendor-owned stock at utility location; returnable_packaging = containers requiring return; project = stock allocated to specific projects.']
  storage_location_code varchar [note: 'Four-character alphanumeric code identifying the specific storage location within the warehouse (e.g., bin, aisle, zone). Used for physical inventory management and picking operations.']
  total_inventory_valuation_amount decimal(18,2) [note: 'Total monetary value of the unrestricted stock quantity at this location, calculated as unrestricted_stock_quantity multiplied by the applicable cost per unit (standard or moving average). Used for balance sheet reporting and working capital analysis. Confidential business financial data.']
  unit_of_measure varchar [note: 'Base unit of measure for all quantity fields in this stock position record (e.g., EA for each, FT for feet, GAL for gallons, TON for tons). Aligns with the material master base UOM.']
  unrestricted_stock_quantity decimal(18,3) [note: 'Quantity of material available for unrestricted use and issue. This is the freely available stock that can be issued to work orders, projects, or consumption without restrictions. Measured in the material base unit of measure (UOM).']
  valuation_currency_code varchar [note: 'Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts in this record (standard cost, moving average cost, total valuation). Typically USD for US-based utilities.']

  Note: 'Real-time and period-end inventory stock position for materials held at utility warehouses, field storerooms, and generation plant stores. Tracks material reference (linked to material_master), storage location (linked to warehouse), unrestricted stock quantity, quality inspection stock, blocked stock, in-transit stock, reserved quantity (backed by material_reservation transactions), issued quantity (backed by goods_issue transactions), consignment stock, reorder point breach flag, safety stock breach flag, last physical inventory count date, and inventory valuation amount at standard or moving average cost. Supports O&M spare parts availability, storm restoration pre-positioning, CAPEX project material staging, and year-end physical inventory reconciliation. Sourced from SAP S/4HANA MM inventory management (MARD/MSKU/MBEW). Stock position is updated by goods_receipt (increase), goods_issue (decrease), stock_transfer (rebalance), and material_reservation (commitment).'
}

  work_order_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the work order for which materials are being reserved. Links to the Enterprise Asset Management (EAM) work order record in Oracle WAM or IBM Maximo that defines the maintenance or operational task requiring these materials.']
  batch_number varchar [note: 'Manufacturer batch or lot number for batch-managed materials. Enables traceability for quality control, warranty claims, and regulatory compliance, particularly for critical spare parts, hazardous materials, and generation plant components.']
  closed_date date [note: 'Date when the material reservation was closed and removed from active planning. Set when the reservation status transitions to fully issued or cancelled, marking the end of the reservations operational lifecycle.']
  cost_center_code varchar [note: 'Financial accounting code identifying the organizational unit or functional area responsible for the costs associated with this material reservation. Used for Operations and Maintenance (O&M) expense allocation and Operating Expenditure (OPEX) tracking when materials are not charged to a Capital Expenditure (CAPEX) project.']
  created_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Date and time when the material reservation record was first created in the Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) system. Audit timestamp capturing the initial transaction event in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX).']
  currency_code varchar [note: 'Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the valuation amount. Typically USD for United States-based utility operations, but may vary for international subsidiaries or cross-border procurement.']
  deletion_indicator boolean [note: 'Flag marking the reservation for deletion or archival. True when the reservation has been cancelled, superseded, or is no longer needed. Soft-delete flag that preserves the record for audit trail while excluding it from active operational views.']
  erp_document_number varchar [note: 'Native document identifier from the source Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) system (SAP S/4HANA or Oracle ERP Cloud). Provides traceability back to the originating system transaction for audit, reconciliation, and support purposes.']
  final_issue_indicator boolean [note: 'Flag set by the issuing warehouse or planner to indicate that no additional material will be issued against this reservation, even if the full reserved quantity has not been withdrawn. Used to close reservations when requirements change or work is completed with less material than originally planned.']
  gl_account_code varchar [note: 'General Ledger (GL) account number to which the material cost will be posted when issued. Determines the financial statement line item and expense or asset category for Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (GAAP) reporting and regulatory rate case cost studies.']
  goods_issue_completed_flag boolean [note: 'Indicator that all required material has been issued from inventory against this reservation. True when issued quantity equals or exceeds reserved quantity and no further withdrawals are expected.']
  issued_quantity decimal(18,3) [note: 'Cumulative quantity of material that has been physically issued from inventory against this reservation. Tracks the amount already withdrawn via goods issue transactions (movement type 261 in SAP).']
  last_modified_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Date and time when the material reservation record was most recently updated. Tracks changes to reservation status, quantities, or other attributes. Audit timestamp in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX).']
  material_number varchar [note: 'Business identifier for the material being reserved. The externally-known material code or Stock Keeping Unit (SKU) from the material master that identifies the specific item type.']
  movement_type varchar [note: 'Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) transaction code that defines the type of inventory movement when goods are issued against this reservation. Standard SAP movement type 261 represents goods issue for order, while other codes may apply for returns, scrapping, or transfers.']
  mutual_aid_indicator boolean [note: 'Flag indicating whether this material reservation supports mutual aid assistance to another utility. True when materials are being pre-staged or allocated for deployment to support neighboring utilities during major storm events or grid emergencies.']
  plant_code varchar [note: 'Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) organizational unit code representing the physical location or operational facility where the material is reserved. Corresponds to generation plants, transmission substations, distribution service centers, or regional operations hubs in the utility network.']
  priority_code varchar [note: 'Business priority level assigned to the material reservation. Determines the sequence for material allocation when inventory is constrained. Emergency and urgent priorities are used for storm restoration, outage response, and critical infrastructure repairs.']
  requester_name varchar [note: 'Name of the employee, planner, or supervisor who created the material reservation. Identifies the person responsible for requesting the material allocation for the work order or project.']
  required_quantity decimal(18,3) [note: 'Total quantity of material requested for reservation. Represents the full amount needed to complete the associated work order, Capital Expenditure (CAPEX) project, or maintenance activity.']
  requirement_date date [note: 'Date by which the reserved material is needed at the work location or project site. Drives material availability planning, warehouse picking schedules, and logistics coordination for Transmission and Distribution (T&D) construction projects, planned maintenance outages, and storm restoration activities.']
  reservation_date date [note: 'Date when the material reservation was created in the Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) system. Represents the business event timestamp for the reservation transaction.']
  reservation_notes varchar [note: 'Free-text field for additional information, special handling instructions, or business context related to the material reservation. May include details about material substitutions, delivery constraints, safety requirements, or coordination with field crews.']
  reservation_number varchar [note: 'Business identifier for the material reservation document. Externally-known unique number assigned by the Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) system (SAP S/4HANA or Oracle ERP Cloud) to track the reservation throughout its lifecycle.']
  reservation_status varchar [note: 'Current lifecycle state of the material reservation. Tracks progression from open (newly created), partially issued (some quantity issued), fully issued (all quantity issued), cancelled (reservation voided), to closed (reservation completed and archived).']
  reservation_type varchar [note: 'Classification of the material reservation based on the business purpose. Distinguishes between work order reservations, Capital Expenditure (CAPEX) project reservations, maintenance activity reservations, storm restoration pre-staging, planned generation outage reservations, and emergency response reservations.']
  reserved_quantity decimal(18,3) [note: 'Actual quantity of material successfully reserved from available inventory stock. May differ from required quantity if insufficient stock is available. This quantity is committed and reduces the unrestricted stock available for other reservations.']
  serial_number varchar [note: 'Unique serial number for serialized materials and equipment. Provides individual asset-level traceability for high-value components such as transformers, circuit breakers, meters, and generation equipment.']
  storage_location_code varchar [note: 'Warehouse or storage location code within the plant from which the material will be issued. Identifies the specific inventory stocking point, yard, or storeroom holding the reserved material.']
  storm_event_reference varchar [note: 'Identifier for the storm or emergency event associated with this material reservation. Used for storm restoration logistics, mutual aid coordination, and Federal Energy Regulatory Commission (FERC) or Public Utility Commission (PUC) storm cost recovery reporting.']
  unit_of_measure varchar [note: 'Standard unit in which the material quantity is expressed. Examples include each (EA), meter (M), kilogram (KG), liter (L), foot (FT), or other industry-standard units aligned with the material master base unit of measure.']
  valuation_amount decimal(18,2) [note: 'Total monetary value of the reserved material quantity. Calculated as reserved quantity multiplied by the material standard cost or moving average price. Used for inventory valuation, Work in Progress (WIP) tracking, and Capital Expenditure (CAPEX) project cost accumulation.']
  wbs_element varchar [note: 'Hierarchical project structure code from the Capital Expenditure (CAPEX) project Work Breakdown Structure (WBS). Identifies the specific project phase, deliverable, or cost element to which this material reservation is charged. Used for project cost tracking and Allowance for Funds Used During Construction (AFUDC) capitalization.']

  Note: 'Transactional record reserving specific materials from inventory stock against a planned work order, CAPEX project WBS element, or maintenance activity. Captures reservation number, material number, required quantity, reserved quantity, movement type (261 goods issue for order), requesting cost center or WBS element, requirement date, reservation status (open, partially issued, fully issued, cancelled), issuing storage location, and SAP reservation document number. Ensures material availability planning for planned maintenance outages, T&D construction projects, and storm restoration pre-staging. Drives the reserved quantity in inventory_stock and prevents over-commitment of critical spare parts.'
}

This is critical for regulated utility mate']

  warehouse_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key reference to the warehouse from which the material was issued.']
