  work_order_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the maintenance or construction work order (from Oracle WAM or IBM Maximo) that generated this OPEX transaction. Enables linkage between O&M labor and materials costs and specific asset maintenance activities. Critical for distinguishing OPEX from CAPEX in rate case filings.']
  approval_status varchar [note: 'Current workflow lifecycle state of the OPEX transaction. Tracks the transaction from initial entry through approval, posting to the general ledger, and potential reversal. Essential for SOX internal controls compliance and financial close processes.']
  approved_by varchar [note: 'Name or employee identifier of the individual who approved this OPEX transaction per the utility\'s delegation of authority matrix. Required for SOX internal controls documentation and financial audit trails. Populated upon transition to \'approved\' or \'posted\' approval_status.']
  approved_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp when the OPEX transaction received final approval in the ERP workflow. Distinct from created_timestamp and updated_timestamp; captures the specific lifecycle event of approval. Used for SOX controls testing and financial close cycle time analysis.']
  budget_amount decimal(18,2) [note: 'Approved O&M budget amount for the cost center and FERC account combination for the applicable fiscal period. Enables budget-to-actual variance analysis at the transaction level. Supports financial planning and rate case test-year budget justification.']
  created_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp when the OPEX transaction record was first created in the source ERP system (SAP S/4HANA or Oracle ERP Cloud). Used for audit trail, SOX compliance, and data lineage tracking in the Silver layer.']
  currency_code varchar [note: 'ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the transaction amount (e.g., \'USD\'). Required for multi-currency ERP environments and FERC financial reporting. Utility operations are predominantly USD but may include CAD for cross-border transmission operations.']
  employee_code varchar [note: 'Reference to the employee associated with this OPEX transaction, applicable for labor cost postings (direct labor, overtime, benefits allocations) originating from the payroll system (SuccessFactors or Workday). Null for non-labor transactions such as vendor invoices or fuel purchases.']
  expense_category varchar [note: 'High-level classification of the operating expenditure type. Categories align with standard O&M cost-of-service study breakdowns used in rate case filings before state Public Utility Commissions (PUCs) and FERC. Labor includes direct and indirect employee costs; contractor_services covers third-party O&M contracts; fuel covers FAC-eligible fuel costs.']
  ferc_account_code varchar [note: 'FERC Uniform System of Accounts account number to which this O&M expense is classified. Electric O&M accounts include the 500-series (Electric Operation) and 500-599 range; Gas O&M accounts include the 800-series (Gas Operation). Directly drives FERC Form 1 (electric) and FERC Form 2 (gas) O&M expense schedule reporting.']
  ferc_account_description varchar [note: 'Descriptive label for the FERC Uniform System of Accounts account code (e.g., \'Account 501 - Fuel\', \'Account 510 - Steam Power Generation Operation\', \'Account 803 - Natural Gas Purchased for Resale\'). Provides human-readable context for financial reporting and rate case cost-of-service studies.']
  fiscal_period varchar [note: 'The fiscal accounting period (1–12 for monthly, or 1–4 for quarterly) within the fiscal year in which this OPEX transaction is recognized. Used for period-end close, monthly O&M variance reporting, and regulatory test-year normalization.']
  fiscal_year varchar [note: 'The fiscal year (four-digit integer, e.g., 2024) in which this OPEX transaction is recognized for financial reporting purposes. Aligns with the utility\'s regulatory fiscal year used in FERC Form 1/2 annual reports and rate case test-year filings.']
  functional_area varchar [note: 'Utility functional area to which this OPEX transaction is attributed, aligned with FERC Uniform System of Accounts functional classifications. Used to allocate O&M costs between electric and gas operations and between generation, transmission, and distribution for rate case cost-of-service studies and FERC Form 1/2 reporting.']
  is_capex_reclassified boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this transaction was initially posted as OPEX but subsequently reclassified as a capital expenditure (CAPEX) following engineering or accounting review. OPEX-to-CAPEX reclassifications are common in utility accounting and are subject to regulatory scrutiny in rate cases.']
  is_fac_eligible boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this OPEX transaction represents a fuel cost eligible for recovery through the Fuel Adjustment Clause (FAC) mechanism. FAC-eligible costs (e.g., natural gas, coal, nuclear fuel purchases) are tracked separately for regulatory pass-through rate adjustments filed with state PUCs.']
  is_rate_case_includable boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this OPEX transaction is includable in the utility\'s rate case cost-of-service study as a recoverable O&M expense. Transactions flagged as non-includable (e.g., lobbying costs, penalties, shareholder expenses) are excluded from the revenue requirement calculation per PUC and FERC guidelines.']
  net_amount decimal(18,2) [note: 'Net total amount of the OPEX transaction after applying overhead allocations, adjustments, and any credits or reversals. Represents the final O&M cost recognized in the general ledger for this transaction. Used as the basis for FERC Form 1/2 O&M expense schedule line items.']
  original_transaction_number varchar [note: 'For reversal or correcting entries, the transaction_number of the original OPEX transaction being reversed or corrected. Enables audit trail linkage between original postings and their reversals. Null for original (non-reversal) transactions.']
  overhead_allocation_amount decimal(18,2) [note: 'Dollar amount of indirect overhead costs allocated to this OPEX transaction using the utility\'s cost allocation methodology (e.g., labor-hour basis, direct-cost basis). Overhead allocations are scrutinized in rate case cost-of-service studies to ensure only appropriate costs are included in revenue requirement calculations.']
  posting_date date [note: 'The date on which the OPEX transaction was posted to the general ledger accounting period. May differ from transaction_date due to accrual adjustments or late postings. Determines the fiscal period for financial statement inclusion.']
  project_code varchar [note: 'Internal project or WBS (Work Breakdown Structure) code from the ERP system to which this OPEX transaction is charged. Used for project-level O&M cost tracking, particularly for multi-year maintenance programs, storm restoration activities, and demand-side management (DSM) program cost tracking.']
  quantity decimal(18,4) [note: 'The quantity of goods, services, or resources consumed in this OPEX transaction (e.g., labor hours, MCF of natural gas, MWh of fuel energy, units of materials). Used in conjunction with unit_of_measure for unit cost analysis and fuel consumption tracking for FAC filings.']
  regulatory_jurisdiction varchar [note: 'The regulatory jurisdiction (e.g., \'FERC\', \'CA-CPUC\', \'TX-PUC\', \'NY-PSC\') under whose rate-making authority this OPEX transaction falls. Used to allocate costs between FERC-jurisdictional (wholesale/transmission) and state PUC-jurisdictional (retail distribution) rate bases in cost-of-service studies.']
  reversal_indicator boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this OPEX transaction is a reversal entry (credit memo or correcting journal entry) that offsets a previously posted transaction. Reversal transactions are common for accrual reversals at period-end and for correcting misposted O&M costs.']
  source_document_type varchar [note: 'Classification of the originating document type that generated this OPEX transaction in the ERP system. Distinguishes between vendor invoices, manual journal entries, period-end accruals, payroll cost allocations, intercompany charges, and goods receipts. Used for financial audit and SOX controls testing.']
  source_system varchar [note: 'Identifies the operational system of record from which this OPEX transaction originated. Supports data lineage tracking in the Databricks Silver layer and enables source-system reconciliation during financial close. Primary sources are SAP S/4HANA or Oracle ERP Cloud for financial postings, with work order costs originating from Oracle WAM or IBM Maximo.']
  transaction_amount decimal(18,2) [note: 'Gross base amount of the operating expenditure in the transaction currency before any adjustments, discounts, or overhead allocations. Represents the raw O&M cost posted to the general ledger. Used for OPEX budget variance analysis and FERC O&M expense reporting.']
  transaction_date date [note: 'The principal real-world business event date on which the operating expenditure was incurred or the cost was recognized. Used for period-end accruals, FERC O&M expense reporting, and rate case cost-of-service study period alignment.']
  transaction_description varchar [note: 'Free-text description of the operating expenditure as entered in the ERP system (SAP S/4HANA or Oracle ERP Cloud). Provides context for the nature of the O&M cost, such as \'Turbine blade inspection labor - Unit 3\' or \'Natural gas fuel purchase - Peaker Plant\'. Used in audit reviews and rate case cost justification.']
  transaction_number varchar [note: 'Externally-known business identifier for the OPEX transaction as assigned by the ERP system (SAP S/4HANA or Oracle ERP Cloud). Corresponds to the document number or journal entry number used in financial reporting and audit trails. Supports FERC Form 1/2 O&M expense reconciliation.']
  unit_of_measure varchar [note: 'The unit of measure for the quantity field (e.g., \'hours\' for labor, \'MCF\' for natural gas volume, \'MWh\' for fuel energy, \'EA\' for each/unit of materials). Enables unit cost calculations and fuel consumption analysis for Fuel Adjustment Clause (FAC) regulatory filings.']
  updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp when the OPEX transaction record was last modified in the source ERP system. Tracks reversals, corrections, and approval workflow updates. Required for incremental ETL processing in the Databricks Silver layer.']
  utility_type varchar [note: 'Identifies whether this OPEX transaction relates to electric utility operations, gas utility operations, or common/shared utility costs. Required for cost separation between electric and gas rate bases in combined electric-and-gas utility rate cases filed with state PUCs and FERC.']
  vendor_invoice_number varchar [note: 'The invoice number provided by the vendor or contractor for this OPEX transaction. Used for three-way match (PO, goods receipt, invoice) in the procure-to-pay process and for SOX accounts payable controls. Enables traceability from the general ledger entry back to the source vendor document.']

  Note: 'Transactional record capturing operating expenditures (O&M costs) posted to the general ledger, including labor, materials, contractor services, fuel costs (FAC-eligible), and overhead allocations. Captures transaction date, amount, FERC O&M account (e.g., Account 500-series for Electric Operation, Account 800-series for Gas Operation), cost center, functional area, expense category, purchase order reference, vendor, and approval status. Supports OPEX tracking against budget, rate case O&M cost-of-service studies, and FERC Form 1/2 O&M expense reporting.'
}

Table finance.profit_center {
  profit_center_id varchar [pk, note: 'Unique surrogate identifier for the profit center record in the Databricks Silver Layer. Primary key generated by the lakehouse ingestion pipeline from SAP S/4HANA CO-PCA module.']
  parent_profit_center_id varchar [note: 'Self-referencing FK on profit_center (parent_profit_center_id)']
  allowed_roe_percent decimal(6,4) [note: 'Regulatory-approved return on equity percentage for this profit center as determined in the most recent rate case or FERC order. Used to calculate the allowed return component in cost-of-service studies and PBR performance tracking.']
  business_segment varchar [note: 'Regulatory and operational business segment to which this profit center belongs. Drives FERC-required segment reporting and ROE/ROI analysis by business unit. Values align with the utility\'s FERC Form 1 and state PUC segment reporting requirements: electric_generation, electric_transmission, electric_distribution, gas_distribution, unregulated.']
  capex_budget_usd decimal(18,2) [note: 'Approved annual capital expenditure budget allocated to this profit center in US dollars. Used for CAPEX tracking, rate base calculations, and AFUDC (Allowance for Funds Used During Construction) accruals in regulatory accounting.']
  ciac_eligible boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this profit center is eligible to receive Contributions in Aid of Construction (CIAC) from customers or developers. CIAC receipts reduce rate base and are tracked separately per FERC Account 271 and state PUC requirements.']
  company_code varchar [note: 'SAP Company Code (BUKRS) representing the legal entity to which this profit center is assigned. Used for GAAP financial statement preparation and SOX compliance segregation. Maps to the utility\'s legal corporate structure.']
  controlling_area_code varchar [note: 'SAP Controlling Area (KOKRS) to which this profit center belongs. Defines the organizational unit within which cost and profit accounting is performed. All profit centers within a controlling area share the same fiscal year variant and currency.']
  cost_center_assignment varchar [note: 'Default cost center code associated with this profit center for overhead allocation and cost-of-service studies. Used in rate case preparation to allocate shared costs between regulated business segments per FERC and PUC requirements.']
  created_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp when this profit center record was first created in the source SAP S/4HANA CO-PCA system. Used for audit trail, SOX compliance, and data lineage tracking in the Databricks Silver Layer.']
  currency_code varchar [note: 'ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the profit center\'s reporting currency (e.g., USD). Defines the currency in which profit center financial results are reported and consolidated.']
  depreciation_method varchar [note: 'Depreciation method applied to capital assets assigned to this profit center. Regulatory depreciation rates are typically set by PUC order and may differ from GAAP depreciation. Impacts rate base calculations and FERC account 403 (Depreciation and Amortization of Electric Plant).']
  energy_commodity varchar [note: 'Primary energy commodity handled by this profit center. Distinguishes electric utility operations from gas distribution operations for FERC Form 1 vs. Form 2 reporting, and for separate rate case cost-of-service studies.']
  ferc_account_class varchar [note: 'FERC Uniform System of Accounts classification associated with this profit center (e.g., Electric Plant in Service accounts 301-399, Gas Plant accounts 101-199). Drives regulatory financial reporting on FERC Form 1 and Form 2.']
  fiscal_year_variant varchar [note: 'SAP Fiscal Year Variant (PERIV) that defines the fiscal year calendar applicable to this profit center. Determines period boundaries for financial reporting, budget cycles, and FERC annual report preparation.']
  functional_area varchar [note: 'SAP Functional Area (FUNC_AREA) assigned to this profit center, used to classify costs by business function (e.g., generation operations, transmission operations, distribution operations, customer service, administration). Supports FERC functional cost classification and CAPEX/OPEX segregation.']
  gl_account_assignment_group varchar [note: 'GL account assignment group that governs automatic account determination for revenue and cost postings to this profit center. Ensures correct FERC account mapping for regulated utility accounting.']
  hierarchy_node varchar [note: 'Node identifier within the SAP profit center standard hierarchy (SETCLASS 0106) to which this profit center is assigned. Enables roll-up reporting across organizational levels for EBITDA and segment reporting.']
  intercompany_elimination_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether transactions posted to this profit center are subject to intercompany elimination in consolidated financial statements. Critical for SOX-compliant consolidation and FERC affiliate transaction reporting.']
  last_modified_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp of the most recent modification to this profit center record in the source SAP S/4HANA CO-PCA system. Supports change tracking, SOX audit requirements, and incremental data pipeline processing.']
  long_description varchar [note: 'Extended description of the profit center providing full business context, including the scope of operations, regulatory segment, and reporting purpose. Corresponds to LTEXT in SAP CEPC.']
  nerc_region varchar [note: 'NERC reliability region (e.g., WECC, SERC, RFC, MRO) associated with this profit center\'s electric operations. Used for NERC compliance reporting and bulk electric system (BES) reliability cost allocation.']
  opex_budget_usd decimal(18,2) [note: 'Approved annual operating expenditure budget allocated to this profit center in US dollars. Supports O&M cost tracking, rate case cost-of-service studies, and EBITDA reporting by segment.']
  plant_location_code varchar [note: 'Geographic or operational location code associated with this profit center, linking it to a specific generation plant, transmission substation, distribution district, or gas service territory. Used in GIS-integrated financial analysis and asset management reporting.']
  profit_center_code varchar [note: 'Externally-known alphanumeric code that uniquely identifies the profit center within the SAP S/4HANA Controlling (CO-PCA) module. Used in journal entries, cost allocations, and regulatory segment reports. Corresponds to the PRCTR field in SAP table CEPC.']
  profit_center_group varchar [note: 'Grouping identifier used to aggregate profit centers for management reporting, EBITDA analysis, and regulatory segment reporting. Corresponds to SAP profit center groups (SETCLASS 0106) used in report painter/writer reports.']
  profit_center_name varchar [note: 'Human-readable short name of the profit center as maintained in SAP CO-PCA (KTEXT field in CEPC). Used in financial reports, dashboards, and rate case cost-of-service studies.']
  profit_center_status varchar [note: 'Current lifecycle status of the profit center record. Active profit centers accept postings; locked centers are frozen for new transactions; inactive centers are retired from use. Corresponds to the LOCK_IND and PRCTR_STATUS indicators in SAP CEPC.']
  profit_center_type varchar [note: 'Classification of the profit center by regulatory and operational type. Regulated centers are subject to PUC/FERC oversight and rate-of-return regulation; unregulated centers operate in competitive markets; corporate centers capture holding company costs; shared_services centers allocate common costs.']
  rate_base_usd decimal(18,2) [note: 'Regulatory rate base value assigned to this profit center in US dollars, representing the net investment on which the utility is permitted to earn a regulated return. Used in ROE calculations and rate case cost-of-service studies filed with FERC and state PUCs.']
  regulatory_jurisdiction varchar [note: 'Indicates the regulatory jurisdiction governing this profit center\'s rates and operations. Federal indicates FERC jurisdiction (transmission, wholesale); state indicates PUC jurisdiction (distribution, retail); both indicates dual jurisdiction; unregulated indicates competitive/non-regulated operations.']
  responsible_manager_code varchar [note: 'Employee identifier of the manager accountable for the financial performance of this profit center. Corresponds to the VERAK field in SAP CEPC. Used for accountability reporting and performance-based ratemaking (PBR) analysis.']
  responsible_manager_name varchar [note: 'Full name of the manager responsible for this profit center\'s financial performance. Sourced from SAP HR/CO integration. Used in management reporting and rate case cost-of-service studies.']
  revenue_budget_usd decimal(18,2) [note: 'Approved annual revenue budget for this profit center in US dollars. Used in ROE and ROI analysis by business unit, EBITDA reporting by segment, and variance analysis against actual revenues.']
  rto_iso_membership varchar [note: 'RTO or ISO market area in which this profit center participates (e.g., PJM, MISO, CAISO, SPP, ERCOT). Drives energy market cost allocation, LMP-based settlement, and OATT compliance reporting.']
  segment_reporting_code varchar [note: 'Code used to map this profit center to a reportable segment under GAAP ASC 280 (Segment Reporting) and FERC segment reporting requirements. Enables aggregation of profit centers into disclosed business segments in annual reports and FERC filings.']
  source_system_code varchar [note: 'Identifier of the operational source system from which this profit center record was ingested (e.g., SAP_S4HANA_PROD, SAP_S4HANA_QA). Supports data lineage, multi-system reconciliation, and Silver Layer provenance tracking.']
  sox_relevant boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this profit center is within scope for SOX internal controls over financial reporting. SOX-relevant profit centers require documented controls, segregation of duties, and periodic management attestation.']
  valid_from_date date [note: 'Date from which this profit center is effective and available for financial postings. Corresponds to DATAB in SAP CEPC. Used to enforce temporal validity in period-based financial reporting and rate case cost studies.']
  valid_to_date date [note: 'Date through which this profit center remains effective. Corresponds to DATBI in SAP CEPC. A value of 9999-12-31 indicates an open-ended profit center with no planned deactivation.']
  wip_account_indicator boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this profit center is designated to capture Work in Progress (WIP) costs for capital projects prior to asset capitalization. When true, costs posted here are subject to AFUDC accrual per FERC accounting requirements.']

  Note: 'Master record for profit centers representing the utility\'s business segments used for internal profitability reporting and regulatory segment reporting. Captures profit center code, description, responsible manager, business segment (electric generation, electric transmission, electric distribution, gas distribution, unregulated), company code, controlling area, and active status. Supports FERC-required segment reporting, ROE (Return on Equity) and ROI analysis by business unit, and EBITDA reporting by segment. Sourced from SAP S/4HANA Controlling (CO-PCA) module.'
}

Table finance.rate_case_cost_study {
  rate_case_cost_study_id varchar [pk, note: 'Unique surrogate identifier for the rate case cost-of-service study record in the Databricks Silver Layer. Primary key for this entity.']
  rate_case_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the parent rate case docket for which this cost-of-service study was prepared. Links to the regulatory.rate_case product.']
  accumulated_depreciation_amount decimal(18,2) [note: 'Total accumulated depreciation deducted from gross plant in service to arrive at net plant in rate base. Expressed in US dollars. Corresponds to FERC Account 108.']
  adit_amount decimal(18,2) [note: 'Accumulated Deferred Income Tax (ADIT) balance deducted from rate base, representing the tax benefits of accelerated depreciation that have been passed through to customers. Expressed in US dollars. Corresponds to FERC Account 190/282/283.']
  afudc_amount decimal(18,2) [note: 'Allowance for Funds Used During Construction (AFUDC) capitalized during the test year, representing the cost of financing construction work in progress (WIP). Expressed in US dollars. Corresponds to FERC Accounts 107 and 432.']
  approved_date date [note: 'Date on which the regulatory authority (PUC or FERC) issued a final order approving the rates derived from this cost-of-service study. Null if the study has not yet received final regulatory approval.']
  authorized_roe_pct decimal(7,4) [note: 'Authorized or proposed Return on Equity (ROE) percentage used in the cost-of-service study to calculate the equity component of the allowed return on rate base. Expressed as a decimal percentage (e.g., 9.5000 for 9.5%). Benchmarked against comparable utility ROE awards by the PUC or FERC.']
  capex_amount decimal(18,2) [note: 'Total Capital Expenditure (CAPEX) included in or supporting the rate base determination for this cost-of-service study. Represents plant additions during the test year or projected capital investment period. Expressed in US dollars.']
  cost_allocation_method varchar [note: 'Methodology used to allocate costs among customer classes or rate jurisdictions in this cost-of-service study. Fully Distributed Cost (FDC) allocates all costs; Marginal Cost reflects incremental costs; Embedded Cost uses historical average costs; Hybrid combines approaches.']
  cost_of_debt_pct decimal(7,4) [note: 'Embedded cost of long-term debt used in the WACC calculation, representing the weighted average interest rate on the utility\'s outstanding debt instruments. Expressed as a decimal percentage (e.g., 4.8500 for 4.85%).']
  cpcn_reference_number varchar [note: 'Reference number of the Certificate of Public Convenience and Necessity (CPCN) application supported by this cost-of-service study, if applicable. Links the cost justification to the capital project authorization for major infrastructure investments.']
  created_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp when this cost-of-service study record was first created in the system. Supports SOX audit trail requirements and record lineage tracking. This is the RECORD_AUDIT_CREATED for this TRANSACTION_HEADER entity.']
  currency_code varchar [note: 'ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary amounts in this cost-of-service study. Typically USD for US utility rate cases. Included to support multi-currency reporting and GAAP financial statement alignment.']
  debt_ratio_pct decimal(7,4) [note: 'Percentage of the capital structure represented by long-term debt, used in the WACC calculation. Expressed as a decimal percentage (e.g., 48.0000 for 48%). Together with equity_ratio_pct must sum to 100%.']
  depreciation_expense_amount decimal(18,2) [note: 'Total depreciation expense included in the revenue requirement for the test year, calculated using depreciation rates approved by the regulatory authority applied to the depreciable plant in service. Expressed in US dollars. Corresponds to FERC Account 403.']
  effective_date date [note: 'Date on which the new rates derived from this cost-of-service study become effective for customer billing. May be subject to refund if rates are later adjusted by the regulatory authority.']
  equity_ratio_pct decimal(7,4) [note: 'Percentage of the capital structure represented by equity, used in the WACC calculation. Expressed as a decimal percentage (e.g., 52.0000 for 52%). Determined by the utility\'s actual or hypothetical capital structure as accepted by the regulatory authority.']
  existing_revenue_amount decimal(18,2) [note: 'Current annual revenue collected under existing rates at the time of the rate case filing. The difference between revenue_requirement_amount and existing_revenue_amount represents the revenue deficiency or excess (rate increase or decrease needed). Expressed in US dollars.']
  filing_date date [note: 'Date on which the cost-of-service study was formally filed with the regulatory authority (PUC or FERC). This is the BUSINESS_EVENT_TIMESTAMP (date precision) for this TRANSACTION_HEADER entity. Triggers statutory review timelines and suspension periods.']
  filing_status varchar [note: 'Current lifecycle status of the cost-of-service study within the rate case workflow. Tracks progression from internal preparation through regulatory submission and disposition. This is the LIFECYCLE_STATUS for this TRANSACTION_HEADER entity.']
  functionalization_method varchar [note: 'Primary functional category used to classify utility costs in this study per FERC Uniform System of Accounts: production, transmission, distribution, customer, or general/administrative. Drives cost allocation to customer classes and rate design. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: production|transmission|distribution|customer|general — promote to reference product if multi-function studies require line-level detail]']
  income_tax_expense_amount decimal(18,2) [note: 'Total income tax expense (federal and state) included in the revenue requirement, calculated on the allowed return on equity component of the rate base. Expressed in US dollars. Includes adjustments for accumulated deferred income taxes (ADIT).']
  irp_reference_number varchar [note: 'Reference number of the Integrated Resource Plan (IRP) submission that this cost-of-service study supports, if applicable. Connects long-term resource planning cost projections to the rate case revenue requirement.']
  jurisdiction_state varchar [note: 'Two-letter US state abbreviation identifying the state PUC jurisdiction for this filing (e.g., CA, TX, NY). Null if the filing is exclusively with FERC. Used to apply state-specific regulatory accounting rules and tariff structures.']
  jurisdiction_type varchar [note: 'Indicates whether this cost-of-service study is filed with a state Public Utility Commission (PUC), the Federal Energy Regulatory Commission (FERC), or both (dual jurisdiction). Determines applicable regulatory accounting standards and reporting requirements.']
  om_expense_amount decimal(18,2) [note: 'Total Operations and Maintenance (O&M) expense included in the revenue requirement for the test year, covering labor, materials, and contracted services for operating and maintaining generation, transmission, and distribution assets. Expressed in US dollars.']
  pbr_target_included boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this cost-of-service study includes Performance-Based Ratemaking (PBR) performance targets or incentive mechanisms as part of the rate design. True if PBR metrics (e.g., SAIDI, SAIFI, customer satisfaction) are incorporated into the revenue requirement or rate structure.']
  prepared_by varchar [note: 'Name or employee identifier of the regulatory analyst or financial professional responsible for preparing this cost-of-service study. Supports SOX accountability and regulatory filing certification requirements. This is the PARTY_REFERENCE for this TRANSACTION_HEADER entity.']
  property_tax_expense_amount decimal(18,2) [note: 'Total property and other taxes (excluding income taxes) included in the revenue requirement for the test year. Expressed in US dollars. Corresponds to FERC Account 408.1.']
  rate_base_amount decimal(18,2) [note: 'Total rate base as determined in this cost-of-service study, representing the net investment on which the utility is entitled to earn a return. Includes net plant in service, working capital, and other allowable investments, less accumulated depreciation and deferred taxes. Expressed in US dollars.']
  revenue_deficiency_amount decimal(18,2) [note: 'Net difference between the total revenue requirement and existing revenues. A positive value indicates a revenue deficiency (rate increase needed); a negative value indicates a revenue surplus (rate decrease). Expressed in US dollars. This is the MONETARY_TRIPLET adjustment/net component.']
  revenue_requirement_amount decimal(18,2) [note: 'Total revenue requirement calculated in this cost-of-service study, representing the total amount the utility is authorized to collect from customers to recover its costs and earn a fair return. Expressed in US dollars. This is the primary MONETARY_TRIPLET gross amount for this TRANSACTION_HEADER entity.']
  settlement_reached boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the rate case associated with this cost-of-service study was resolved through a negotiated settlement agreement among the utility, regulatory staff, and intervening parties, rather than a fully litigated proceeding.']
  study_description varchar [note: 'Narrative description of the scope, purpose, and key assumptions of this cost-of-service study. Includes summary of major cost drivers, significant adjustments from prior rate case, and any unusual items requiring regulatory explanation.']
  study_number varchar [note: 'Externally-known alphanumeric identifier assigned to this cost-of-service study, used in regulatory filings and cross-referenced in dockets. Typically formatted as a combination of jurisdiction code, year, and sequence (e.g., CA-GRC-2024-001). This is the BUSINESS_IDENTIFIER for this TRANSACTION_HEADER entity.']
  study_type varchar [note: 'Classification of the rate case type for which this cost-of-service study is prepared. Determines the applicable regulatory framework, tariff schedules, and cost allocation methodology. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: general_rate_case|transmission_rate_case|gas_rate_case|distribution_rate_case|limited_rate_case — promote to reference product if additional types are needed]']
  study_version varchar [note: 'Version number of this cost-of-service study, incremented when the study is revised during the regulatory proceeding (e.g., in response to data requests, settlement negotiations, or updated actuals). Version 1 is the initial filing; subsequent versions reflect amendments.']
  test_year_end_date date [note: 'End date of the test year used as the basis for cost-of-service calculations. Together with test_year_start_date, defines the 12-month test period. May be historical (fully known actuals) or projected (future test year with estimates).']
  test_year_start_date date [note: 'Start date of the test year (historical or projected) used as the basis for cost-of-service calculations. The test year is the 12-month period whose costs and revenues form the foundation of the revenue requirement determination.']
  test_year_type varchar [note: 'Indicates whether the test year is based on historical actuals, a projected future period, or a hybrid combining historical data with known and measurable adjustments. Affects the level of regulatory scrutiny and the types of adjustments permitted.']
  updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp when this cost-of-service study record was last modified. Supports SOX audit trail and change management tracking. This is the RECORD_AUDIT_UPDATED for this TRANSACTION_HEADER entity.']
  wacc_pct decimal(7,4) [note: 'Weighted Average Cost of Capital (WACC) used to determine the overall allowed rate of return on rate base, blending the cost of debt and equity weighted by their respective proportions in the capital structure. Expressed as a decimal percentage (e.g., 7.2500 for 7.25%).']
  working_capital_amount decimal(18,2) [note: 'Working capital allowance included in rate base, representing the utility\'s investment in cash, materials, supplies, and prepayments needed to operate the business between billing cycles. Expressed in US dollars.']

  Note: 'Master record for cost-of-service studies prepared in support of rate case filings with state PUCs or FERC. Captures rate case identifier, filing jurisdiction (PUC state, FERC), test year, rate case type (general rate case, transmission rate case, gas rate case), total revenue requirement, rate base amount, authorized ROE, WACC, O&M expense allocation, depreciation expense, taxes, and filing status. Links to supporting GL accounts, cost centers, and CAPEX projects. Supports CPCN applications, IRP cost justifications, and PBR performance target derivation.'
}

Table finance.financial_period {
  financial_period_id varchar [pk, note: 'Unique surrogate identifier for each fiscal period record in the financial reporting calendar. Primary key for the financial_period data product.']
  prior_year_period_financial_period_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the corresponding fiscal period in the prior year, enabling year-over-year financial comparisons in regulatory filings, earnings reports, and rate case testimony. For example, Period 3 FY2024 links to Period 3 FY2023.']

  budget_period_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this fiscal period has an approved operating budget loaded in the financial planning system.   calendar_end_date date [note: 'The calendar date on which this fiscal period ends (inclusive). Defines the boundary for accruals, revenue recognition cut-offs, and period-end close procedures. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.']
  calendar_month varchar [note: 'The calendar month number (1–12) corresponding to this fiscal period. For regular periods, this aligns with the calendar month.   calendar_start_date date [note: 'The calendar date on which this fiscal period begins (inclusive). Used to align fiscal period boundaries with calendar-month meter reads, billing cycles, energy market settlement dates, and regulatory reporting windows. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.']
  calendar_year varchar [note: 'The four-digit calendar year corresponding to this fiscal period. May differ from fiscal_year for utilities operating on a non-calendar fiscal year (e.g., April–March). Required for aligning fiscal periods with calendar-year regulatory reporting and energy market settlement calendars.']
  close_workflow_status varchar [note: 'Tracks the current state of the period-end or year-end close workflow for this fiscal period. \'not_started\' = close activities not yet initiated; \'in_progress\' = close tasks underway; \'completed\' = all close tasks finished; \'approved\' = controller/CFO sign-off obtained; \'failed\' = close workflow encountered errors requiring remediation.']
  company_code varchar [note: 'The SAP company code or Oracle ERP legal entity identifier for which this fiscal period is defined.   created_timestamp timestamp [note: 'The date and time when this fiscal period record was first created in the financial system (SAP S/4HANA or Oracle ERP Cloud). Provides an audit trail for period configuration changes. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.']
  days_in_period varchar [note: 'The total number of calendar days in this fiscal period (derived from calendar_start_date and calendar_end_date). Stored explicitly to avoid runtime date arithmetic in reporting queries.']
  depreciation_run_status varchar [note: 'Indicates the status of the periodic depreciation calculation run for utility plant assets in this fiscal period. \'not_run\' = depreciation not yet calculated; \'in_progress\' = depreciation run executing; \'completed\' = calculated but not yet posted; \'posted\' = depreciation journal entries posted to the GL. Critical for CAPEX tracking and FERC plant account reporting.']
  ferc_reporting_year varchar [note: 'The FERC reporting year to which this fiscal period\'s financial data is attributed for FERC Form 1 (electric) and FERC Form 2 (gas) annual report submissions. May differ from fiscal_year for utilities with non-calendar fiscal years. Ensures correct period-to-FERC-filing alignment for regulatory compliance.']
  fiscal_quarter varchar [note: 'The fiscal quarter (1–4) to which this period belongs. Derived from period_number but stored explicitly to support quarterly financial reporting, quarterly FERC filings, and quarterly earnings disclosures without requiring runtime computation.']
  fiscal_year varchar [note: 'The four-digit fiscal year to which this period belongs (e.g., 2024). May differ from the calendar year when the utility operates on a non-calendar fiscal year variant. Used for annual financial reporting, FERC Form 1 submissions, and rate case cost-of-service studies.']
  fiscal_year_variant varchar [note: 'The fiscal year variant code from SAP S/4HANA (e.g., \'K4\' for calendar-year variant, \'V3\' for April–March) or equivalent accounting calendar identifier from Oracle ERP Cloud. Determines the mapping between fiscal periods and calendar months. Essential for multi-entity utilities operating under different fiscal calendars.']
  intercompany_elimination_status varchar [note: 'Tracks whether intercompany transaction eliminations have been completed for this fiscal period in consolidated financial statements.   is_adjustment_period boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this is a special adjustment period (periods 13–16) used for post-close audit adjustments, regulatory accounting entries, or tax provision postings that must be segregated from regular operating period activity.   is_open_for_asset_posting boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the asset accounting sub-ledger is open for depreciation runs, asset acquisitions, retirements, and transfers in this fiscal period.   is_open_for_co_posting boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the cost controlling module is open for internal order settlements, cost center allocations, and profit center postings in this fiscal period.   is_open_for_gl_posting boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the general ledger module is currently open for journal entry postings in this fiscal period.   is_open_for_mm_posting boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the materials management module is open for goods receipts, inventory movements, and purchase order invoice verifications in this fiscal period.   last_updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'The date and time when this fiscal period record was most recently modified (e.g., status change from open to closed, lock applied).   ledger_type varchar [note: 'Identifies the accounting ledger to which this period definition applies. \'leading\' = primary GAAP ledger; \'extension\' = parallel ledger for IFRS or tax accounting; \'regulatory\' = FERC regulatory accounting ledger. Utilities maintain parallel ledgers to reconcile GAAP financial statements with FERC Uniform System of Accounts regulatory books.']
  period_close_timestamp timestamp [note: 'The date and time when this fiscal period was officially closed following completion of period-end close procedures (accruals, reconciliations, depreciation runs, allocations).   period_description varchar [note: 'Free-text description providing additional context about this fiscal period, such as special close instructions, regulatory filing notes, or explanations for non-standard adjustment periods. Used by the financial close team and external auditors for period documentation.']
  period_lock_timestamp timestamp [note: 'The date and time when this fiscal period was hard-locked, preventing any further postings including adjustments. Represents the final SOX control point after which no unauthorized changes can be made to the period\'s financial data. Null if the period has not been locked. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.']
  period_name varchar [note: 'Human-readable label for the fiscal period (e.g., \'January 2024\', \'Q1 2024 Adjustment\', \'Year-End Close 2024\'). Used in financial reports, dashboards, and regulatory filings for display purposes.']
  period_number varchar [note: 'The sequential period number within the fiscal year. Regular operating periods are numbered 1 through 12 (monthly). Adjustment and special closing periods are numbered 13 through 16 per SAP S/4HANA fiscal year variant conventions. Controls which posting periods are open in the general ledger, asset accounting, and cost controlling modules.']
  period_open_timestamp timestamp [note: 'The date and time when this fiscal period was officially opened for journal entry postings. Provides an audit trail for period lifecycle management and SOX compliance. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.']
  period_short_code varchar [note: 'Compact alphanumeric code uniquely identifying the fiscal period in the format YYYY.PPP (e.g., \'2024.001\' for Period 1 of FY2024, \'2024.013\' for the first adjustment period). Used as a display key in financial reports, journal entry headers, and regulatory filings where space is constrained.']
  period_status varchar [note: 'Current lifecycle state of the fiscal period controlling whether journal entry postings are permitted. \'open\' = postings allowed; \'closed\' = period-end close completed, no new postings; \'locked\' = SOX-compliant hard lock preventing any unauthorized postings; \'future\' = period not yet reached. Critical SOX internal control — period lock prevents unauthorized retroactive postings to closed periods.']
  period_type varchar [note: 'Classifies the nature of the fiscal period. \'regular\' = standard monthly operating period (1-12); \'adjustment\' = post-close adjustment period (13-14); \'year_end_closing\' = year-end closing period (15); \'special\' = utility-specific special posting period (16). Determines which business transactions and journal entry types are permitted during the period.']
  rate_case_test_year_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this fiscal period falls within the designated test year for an active or pending rate case proceeding before the PUC or FERC.   regulatory_reporting_period boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this fiscal period aligns with a mandatory regulatory reporting deadline (e.g., FERC Form 1 annual filing, quarterly PUC financial reports, NERC reliability reporting).   source_system_period_key varchar [note: 'The natural key or technical identifier for this fiscal period as it exists in the originating source system (e.g., SAP S/4HANA fiscal year + posting period concatenation \'202401\', or Oracle ERP Cloud period_name \'Jan-24\').   sox_certification_status varchar [note: 'Tracks the SOX Section 302/404 internal control certification status for this fiscal period. \'not_required\' = period not subject to SOX certification (e.g., interim adjustment periods); \'pending\' = certification in progress; \'certified\' = management certification completed with no material weaknesses; \'exceptions_noted\' = material weakness or significant deficiency identified.']

  Note: 'Reference master for fiscal periods and fiscal years used across the utilitys financial reporting calendar. Governs which periods are open for journal entry posting, controls period-end and year-end close workflows, ensures consistent fiscal period alignment across GL, asset accounting, cost controlling, and regulatory reporting modules. Critical for SOX compliance — period lock controls prevent unauthorized postings to closed periods. Sourced from SAP S/4HANA FI fiscal year variant configuration or Oracle ERP Cloud accounting calendar.'

  pre_tax_book_income decimal(18,2) [note: 'Pre-tax book income for the provision period per GAAP financial statements, serving as the starting point for the tax provision calculation and effective rate reconciliation.']
  prepared_by varchar [note: 'Name or identifier of the tax professional or system user who prepared this tax provision calculation.']

  provision_period_end_date date [note: 'End date of the period covered by this tax provision calculation, typically the last day of a fiscal quarter or year.']
  provision_period_start_date date [note: 'Start date of the period covered by this tax provision calculation, typically the first day of a fiscal quarter or year.']
  provision_status varchar [note: 'Current lifecycle status of the tax provision record indicating its stage in the approval and posting workflow.']
  provision_type varchar [note: 'Classification of the tax provision indicating whether it is a regular quarterly provision, annual provision, interim adjustment, amended filing, or year-end true-up calculation.']
  rate_base_adit_offset decimal(18,2) [note: 'ADIT amount used to reduce rate base in regulatory ratemaking, representing zero-cost capital that reduces the utility\'s investment base for return calculation purposes.']
  rate_case_test_year_flag boolean [note: 'Boolean indicator identifying whether this provision period is part of a rate case test year, requiring special normalization and adjustment procedures for regulatory filings.']
  reviewed_by varchar [note: 'Name or identifier of the senior tax professional or manager who reviewed and validated this tax provision calculation.']
  state_tax_jurisdiction varchar [note: 'State tax jurisdiction code or abbreviation identifying the primary state tax authority for this provision, critical for multi-state utilities with apportionment requirements.']
  statutory_federal_tax_rate_pct decimal(5,2) [note: 'Statutory federal income tax rate percentage in effect for the provision period, currently 21% post-TCJA, used as the baseline for effective rate reconciliation.']
  statutory_state_tax_rate_pct decimal(5,2) [note: 'Statutory state income tax rate percentage in effect for the provision period in the primary state jurisdiction, used for state tax expense calculation.']
  taxable_income decimal(18,2) [note: 'Taxable income calculated per Internal Revenue Code for the provision period, after adjusting book income for permanent and temporary differences.']
  temporary_difference_amount decimal(18,2) [note: 'Total temporary differences between book and tax income that will reverse in future periods, giving rise to deferred tax assets or liabilities.']
  total_tax_expense decimal(18,2) [note: 'Total income tax expense for the provision period, calculated as the sum of current and deferred federal and state tax expenses.']
  uncertain_tax_position_reserve decimal(18,2) [note: 'Reserve established for uncertain tax positions under FIN 48 (ASC 740-10) where the utility has taken a tax position that may not be sustained upon examination by tax authorities.']
  updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Date and time when this tax provision record was last modified, supporting audit trail and change tracking requirements.']
  valuation_allowance decimal(18,2) [note: 'Valuation allowance established against deferred tax assets when it is more likely than not that some portion will not be realized, per GAAP ASC 740 guidance.']

  Note: 'Periodic record for income tax provisions, deferred income tax calculations, and Accumulated Deferred Income Taxes (ADIT) balances for the utility. Captures tax provision period, fiscal year, current federal tax expense, current state tax expense, deferred federal tax expense, deferred state tax expense, ADIT balance by timing difference category (accelerated depreciation, regulatory liabilities, pension obligations, storm cost deferrals, excess deferred income taxes — EDIT), federal vs. state tax jurisdiction, effective tax rate, statutory tax rate, permanent and temporary difference reconciliation items, and ITC (Investment Tax Credit) amortization. Supports FERC Form 1 Schedule 272 (Accumulated Deferred Income Taxes), rate base ADIT offset calculations per IRS normalization rules, GAAP ASC 740 income tax accounting, rate case test year tax expense normalization, and Tax Cuts and Jobs Act (TCJA) excess ADIT amortization tracking. Essential for regulatory accounting where ADIT directly reduces rate base.'
}

  Note: 'Master record for regulatory assets and regulatory liabilities recognized under ASC 980 (Regulated Operations) that represent costs or revenues deferred for future rate recovery or refund. Captures deferral type (regulatory asset or regulatory liability), deferral category (storm cost, pension/OPEB, fuel adjustment clause under/over-recovery, environmental remediation, rate case expense, EDIT — Excess Deferred Income Taxes), authorized deferral amount, amortization method, amortization period, remaining unamortized balance, PUC/FERC authorization reference, and deferral status. Supports FERC Form 1 Schedules 232 (Regulatory Assets) and 254 (Regulatory Liabilities), rate case revenue requirement calculations, and GAAP balance sheet presentation under ASC 980.'
}

  entry_number varchar [note: 'Business identifier for the regulatory asset or liability entry, used for external reporting and cross-referencing in rate case filings and regulatory submissions.']
  entry_status varchar [note: 'Current lifecycle status of the regulatory asset or liability entry, tracking its progression from initial recording through amortization to retirement or transfer. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: active|pending_approval|approved|amortizing|fully_amortized|retired|transferred — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]']
  entry_type varchar [note: 'Classification of the regulatory accounting entry indicating whether it represents a regulatory asset, regulatory liability, deferred debit, deferred credit, construction work in progress (CWIP), or plant in service.']

  functional_class varchar [note: 'Functional classification of the regulatory asset or liability within utility operations, aligning with FERC functional cost categories for rate base allocation and cost-of-service studies.']
  is_afudc_eligible boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this regulatory asset is eligible for accrual of Allowance for Funds Used During Construction (AFUDC), representing the cost of capital during the construction period.']
  is_cwip_eligible boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this entry represents construction work in progress that is eligible for inclusion in rate base before the asset is placed in service, subject to regulatory approval.']
  is_rate_base_eligible boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this regulatory asset is eligible for inclusion in the rate base for calculation of allowed return on equity (ROE) and revenue requirement in rate case proceedings.']
  jurisdiction_state varchar [note: 'Two-letter state code identifying the specific state Public Utility Commission (PUC) jurisdiction for state-regulated regulatory assets and liabilities.']
  original_amount decimal(18,2) [note: 'Original dollar value of the regulatory asset or liability at the time of initial recognition, representing the total amount authorized for recovery or refund before any amortization.']

Table finance.depreciation_study {
  depreciation_study_id varchar [pk, note: 'Primary key for depreciation_study']
  prior_depreciation_study_id varchar [note: 'Self-referencing FK on depreciation_study (prior_depreciation_study_id)']
  prior_study_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the previous depreciation study that this study supersedes or updates. Nullable for initial studies.']
  accumulated_depreciation_amount decimal(18,2) [note: 'Total accumulated depreciation reserve for all assets in the study scope as of the study analysis date, measured in US dollars.']
  actuarial_method varchar [note: 'Statistical method used to estimate service life and survivor characteristics of asset groups. Iowa curves are industry standard for utility depreciation studies.']
  annual_depreciation_expense decimal(18,2) [note: 'Projected annual depreciation expense resulting from the rates recommended in this study, measured in US dollars.']
  approval_date date [note: 'Date when the regulatory body officially approved the depreciation study and its recommended rates. Nullable for pending or internal studies.']
  approval_order_number varchar [note: 'Official order or decision number issued by the regulatory body approving the depreciation study. Nullable for unapproved studies.']
  asset_base_amount decimal(18,2) [note: 'Total gross plant value (original cost) of all assets included in the scope of this depreciation study, measured in US dollars.']
  average_remaining_life_years decimal(5,2) [note: 'Weighted average remaining service life for existing assets in the study scope, measured in years.']
  average_service_life_years decimal(5,2) [note: 'Weighted average estimated service life across all asset classes included in the study, measured in years.']
  consultant_firm_name varchar [note: 'Name of the external consulting firm that prepared or assisted with the depreciation study. Nullable if study was performed entirely in-house.']
  created_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp when this depreciation study record was first created in the system.']
  depreciation_method varchar [note: 'Primary depreciation calculation methodology applied in this study. Straight-line is most common for utility assets under FERC guidelines. Remaining life and equal life group methods are used for mass property accounts.']
  effective_date date [note: 'Date when the depreciation rates and parameters from this study become effective for accounting and regulatory purposes.']
  expiration_date date [note: 'Date when the depreciation study parameters are scheduled to be superseded by a new study. Nullable for studies with indefinite applicability.']
  filing_date date [note: 'Date when the depreciation study was officially filed with the regulatory body. Nullable for internal studies.']
  filing_docket_number varchar [note: 'Official docket or case number assigned by the regulatory body when the depreciation study is filed for approval. Nullable for internal studies not requiring regulatory filing.']
  gaap_compliance_indicator boolean [note: 'Flag indicating whether the depreciation study methodology and rates comply with Generally Accepted Accounting Principles. True for studies used in GAAP financial reporting.']
  last_modified_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp when this depreciation study record was most recently updated in the system.']
  lead_analyst_name varchar [note: 'Name of the primary analyst or actuary responsible for conducting the depreciation study.']
  net_book_value_amount decimal(18,2) [note: 'Net plant value (gross plant minus accumulated depreciation) for all assets in the study scope, measured in US dollars.']
  net_salvage_percent decimal(5,2) [note: 'Weighted average net salvage value as a percentage of original cost across all asset classes. Net salvage represents gross salvage minus cost of removal. Can be negative when removal costs exceed salvage value.']
  notes varchar [note: 'Additional notes, comments, or special considerations related to the depreciation study, including any deviations from standard methodology or unique circumstances.']
  rate_case_docket_number varchar [note: 'Docket number of the associated rate case if this study was prepared for rate case purposes. Nullable if not associated with a rate case.']
  rate_case_indicator boolean [note: 'Flag indicating whether this depreciation study was prepared specifically to support a rate case filing. True if study is part of rate case, false otherwise.']
  regulatory_body varchar [note: 'Name of the specific regulatory agency or commission that has jurisdiction over this depreciation study (e.g., FERC, state public utility commission name).']
  regulatory_jurisdiction varchar [note: 'Primary regulatory jurisdiction governing this depreciation study. Federal studies follow FERC guidelines, state studies follow public utility commission requirements, and multi-jurisdictional studies address multiple regulatory bodies.']
  sox_compliance_indicator boolean [note: 'Flag indicating whether this depreciation study was subject to Sarbanes-Oxley internal control requirements and review. True for studies affecting financial statements of publicly traded utilities.']
  study_completion_date date [note: 'Date when the depreciation study analysis was completed and finalized for submission or approval.']
  study_documentation_url varchar [note: 'File path or URL to the complete depreciation study report and supporting documentation in the document management system.']
  study_name varchar [note: 'Descriptive name of the depreciation study, typically including the asset class or scope covered.']
  study_number varchar [note: 'Business identifier for the depreciation study, typically formatted as DS-YYYY-NNNN where YYYY is year and NNNN is sequence number.']
  study_scope_description varchar [note: 'Detailed description of the asset classes, FERC accounts, and organizational units covered by this depreciation study.']
  study_start_date date [note: 'Date when the depreciation study analysis and data collection commenced.']
  study_status varchar [note: 'Current lifecycle status of the depreciation study. Tracks progression from initial draft through regulatory approval and implementation.']
  study_type varchar [note: 'Classification of the depreciation study based on scope and purpose. Comprehensive studies cover all asset classes, interim studies update specific parameters, special studies address unique circumstances, rate case studies support regulatory filings, and asset class specific studies focus on particular equipment categories.']

  Note: 'Master reference table for depreciation_study. Referenced by depreciation_study_id.'
}

  emergency_contact_relationship varchar [note: 'Relationship of the emergency contact to the employee (e.g., spouse, parent, sibling, friend).']
  employee_number varchar [note: 'Externally-known unique employee identifier assigned by human resources. Used on badges, timesheets, and payroll systems.']
  employment_status varchar [note: 'Current lifecycle status of the employee within the organization. Determines access rights and payroll processing.']
  employment_type varchar [note: 'Classification of the employee\'s employment arrangement. Determines benefits eligibility and scheduling rules.']
  ethnicity varchar [note: 'Self-identified ethnicity of the employee. Used for diversity reporting and compliance with equal employment opportunity regulations.']
  exempt_status varchar [note: 'Indicates whether the employee is exempt or non-exempt from overtime pay requirements under FLSA regulations.']
  first_name varchar [note: 'Legal first name of the employee as recorded in human resources systems.']
  gender varchar [note: 'Self-identified gender of the employee. Used for diversity reporting and compliance with equal employment opportunity regulations.']
  hire_date date [note: 'Date the employee was originally hired by the organization. Used for seniority and benefits calculations.']
  job_code varchar [note: 'Standardized code representing the employee\'s job classification. Used for compensation and workforce planning.']
  job_title varchar [note: 'Official job title or position name assigned to the employee. Reflects role and responsibilities.']
  last_name varchar [note: 'Legal last name (surname) of the employee as recorded in human resources systems.']
  last_performance_review_date date [note: 'Date of the most recent formal performance review or appraisal for the employee.']
  last_safety_training_date date [note: 'Date the employee last completed mandatory safety training. Critical for utility operations where employees work with high-voltage equipment and hazardous conditions.']

  national_id_number varchar [note: 'Government-issued national identification number (e.g., Social Security Number in USA). Used for tax reporting and benefits administration.']
  pay_grade varchar [note: 'Compensation grade or band assigned to the employee. Determines salary range and benefits tier.']
  phone_number varchar [note: 'Primary contact phone number for the employee. May be mobile or desk phone.']
  security_clearance_level varchar [note: 'Level of security clearance granted to the employee for access to critical infrastructure and sensitive systems. Required for employees working on generation, transmission, or distribution control systems.']
  termination_date date [note: 'Date the employee\'s employment ended. Null for active employees.']
  union_code varchar [note: 'Code identifying the specific labor union to which the employee belongs. Null for non-union employees.']
  union_member_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the employee is a member of a labor union. Affects collective bargaining agreement applicability.']

  work_schedule_type varchar [note: 'Type of work schedule assigned to the employee. Utility operations often require 24/7 coverage with rotating shifts for plant operators and field crews.']

  Note: 'Master reference table for employee. Referenced by contract_owner_employee_id.'
}

Table workforce.department {
  department_id varchar [pk, note: 'Primary key for department']
  budget_amount_annual decimal(18,2) [note: 'The total annual operating budget allocated to the department in US dollars for the current fiscal year.']
  business_unit_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the business unit or division to which this department belongs within the utility company organizational structure.']
  city varchar [note: 'City where the department is physically located. Organizational contact data classified as confidential.']
  cost_center_code varchar [note: 'Financial accounting code used to track expenses and budget allocation for the department. Used in general ledger and financial reporting systems.']
  country_code varchar [note: 'Three-letter ISO country code where the department is located.']
  created_timestamp timestamp [note: 'The date and time when this department record was first created in the system.']
  department_code varchar [note: 'Short alphanumeric code used to identify the department in business systems and reporting. Typically used in payroll, timekeeping, and financial systems.']
  department_name varchar [note: 'Full official name of the department as recognized within the organization.']
  department_type varchar [note: 'Classification of the department based on its primary function within the utility organization.']
  description varchar [note: 'Detailed description of the department\'s purpose, responsibilities, and scope of operations within the utility organization.']
  effective_end_date date [note: 'The date when the department was closed, merged, or ceased operations. Null for currently active departments.']
  effective_start_date date [note: 'The date when the department was officially established or became operational within the organization.']
  email_address varchar [note: 'Primary email address for department communications and inquiries. Organizational contact data classified as confidential.']
  emergency_response_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the department is designated as part of the utility\'s emergency response and restoration operations for outages and critical incidents.']
  headcount_actual varchar [note: 'The current number of employees actively assigned to the department.']
  headcount_authorized varchar [note: 'The approved number of full-time equivalent positions allocated to the department by organizational planning and budgeting.']
  last_modified_timestamp timestamp [note: 'The date and time when this department record was most recently updated in the system.']
  location_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the primary physical location or facility where the department operates.']
  manager_employee_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the employee who serves as the department manager or head.']
  parent_department_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the parent department in the organizational hierarchy. Null for top-level departments.']
  phone_number varchar [note: 'Primary contact phone number for the department. Organizational contact data classified as confidential.']
  physical_address_line1 varchar [note: 'First line of the department\'s physical address including street number and name. Organizational contact data classified as confidential.']
  physical_address_line2 varchar [note: 'Second line of the department\'s physical address for suite, floor, or building information. Organizational contact data classified as confidential.']
  postal_code varchar [note: 'Postal or ZIP code for the department\'s physical location. Organizational contact data classified as confidential.']
  regulatory_oversight_body varchar [note: 'Name of the primary regulatory agency or commission that oversees the department\'s operations (e.g., FERC, state public utility commission, EPA, NERC).']
  safety_sensitive_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the department performs safety-sensitive functions requiring enhanced safety protocols, drug testing, and regulatory compliance per Federal Energy Regulatory Commission (FERC) and Occupational Safety and Health Administration (OSHA) standards.']
  service_area varchar [note: 'The primary utility service area or operational domain that the department supports within the energy value chain.']
  state_province varchar [note: 'Two-letter state or province code where the department is located. Organizational contact data classified as confidential.']
  status varchar [note: 'Current operational status of the department indicating whether it is actively functioning within the organization.']
  union_representation_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether employees in this department are represented by a labor union or collective bargaining agreement.']

  Note: 'Master reference table for department. Referenced by department_id.'
}
